tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru bhaṭ+ṭa mañdzu gho ṣa rat+na sa mu dra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin dang sangs rgyas gsung rab rin chen gyi/ /rmad byung byin rlabs bka' babs brnyes pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mchog /khams gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi bla ma spyan snga rin chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhabs zung pad mor bdag cag snying nas dad pas 'dud/ /skyes chen gang gi rnam thar dpag yas las/ /mtshon pa tsam zhig bdag yid dad pa'i blos/ /legs par spel ba'i byin rlabs 'dod dgu yi/ /char 'bebs 'di la skal bzang dad pas nyon/ /de la 'dir/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog rgya mtsho zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa 'di nyid gnas gang du rigs kyi khyad par ji lta bu las 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi snying po las byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya gzhal ba'i gnas/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas bskor ba'i ljongs/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi khyad par gyi gdul bya kha ba can gyi sa'i cha/ byang phyogs chos skyong ba'i rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu rim par byon nas/ zhi ba dang dbu rmog btsan po lugs gnyis kyi rgyal rnga cher brdungs te/ sa chen po khor yug dang bcas pa mnga' 'bangs su phab/ rgyal srid chos kyi khrims kyis bde bar bskyangs pas/ skye dgu rnams rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la dga' mgur rol ba'i chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i yul gru mus nya mo gling skya zhes pa ste gnas de'i yon tan gyi khyad par yang /

bsngags 'os grub rigs zhabs rdul gtsang ma yis/ /bstar byas sa gzhi mdzes pa 'di dag kyang / /rgyal sras mchod la mngon sbyor 'dun pa'i blos/ /ne'u gseng zol gyis mnyam par 'khod pa bzhin/ /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dang gdugs/ /dpal gyi rnga yab bzhad ldan rgyal mtshan bcas/ /rtags brgyad mchod pa'i rdzas gyur 'di dag kyang / /ri brag tshul gyis phyogs phyogs mdzes par brgyan/ /phyogs mtshams bar bar dag nas chu rgyun tshogs/ /lhung lhung 'bab pa'i zegs ma 'thor ba yang / /'byon 'gyur rgyal ba'i sras la mngon dga' bas/ /sa rdul tshogs la chag chag 'debs pa bzhin/ /puṣ+pa me tog rab rgyas yid 'ong nags kyi mthongs/ /sna tshogs yal gas mdzes pa'i ge sar rtser/ /rang byung snyan par sgrog pa bung ba'i khyu/ /dga' bas phyogs 'dir 'khor zhing lding ba snyam/ /dwangs pa'i chu rgyun gyis mdzes mtsho ldeng dkar/ /ngar ngur chu bya sna tshogs mgrin sdebs nas/ /snyan 'jebs gdang gi rol mo sgrog pa yang / /sems dpa' mchog la bstod pa sgrub pa bzhin/ /gang yang sa yi khyon 'di dag /dkon mchog rin chen gyis bsten pas/ /dge legs rgya mtsho'i snod nyid ces/ /lha rtsen dga' ma dbyangs su 'tsher/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa'i sa'i phyogs/ sngon 'phrang brag dmar ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkha' chen bya 'phrang pa dang / de'i gdan sa paṇ+ḍi ta byang chub dar ma zhes pas bsten cing / bzung ba'i gnas brag mkhar dgon zhes par/ thog ma'i gdung ni byang dang ra zhes pa nas byon pa/ dpon dge 'dun bzang po yin la/ spyir rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /zhes pa'i don yang / rigs ni gang las 'ong pa'i gdung gis mtshon zhing / rus pa ni gang gi sngon du byang chub sems dpa' byung ba/ zhes gnyag chen bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang chos bzang dpal/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros grub sogs grub pa'i sar bzhugs pa ji snyed byung bas legs par grub cing /

ched du rgyal po'i bla'i smon pa mi dgur grags pa'i nang nas/ stong zhes pa'i rus yin no/ /cho 'brang ni/ ma la sogs pa dang legs par 'brel ba'i gnyen dang / zhes sogs kyis gsal bar byas pa yin la/ sngon rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi phyag phyir/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub nyid dkris te/ rta mo shar gyi chab tshan la phebs skabs/ nged kyi yab mes thog ma byang dang ra phyogs nas dgon pa ya gir gnas gzhi phab pa yin gsungs/ brag mkhar dgon pa la phyag mdzub gtad nas ston par mdzad pa yin zhes rje dkon mchog lhun grub dngos kyi gsung las zhal slob 'gas thos par snang ngo / /dpon dge 'dun bzang po la sras gnyis byung ba'i/ gcung ni gle lung mkhan chen shāka mgon pa'i drung du/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan bsod nams dbang phyug mgon du btags shing / nyan chen pa/ chu bzang pa/ mus chen pa gsum rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bus tshim par mdzad de/ phyis mdog gi gnyag phur dgon pa btab/ snyung bar gnas pa khri tsho tshang bar mdzad pa'i mthar dag pa mkha' spyod du byon pa yin zhing / gcen gyi sras slob dpon chos mchog de'i sras dge bsnyen mi bskyod pa/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba sngags 'chang chos bzang dpal zhes pa/ yab mes rta stod dgon par bzhugs te/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos la nyams len mdzad cing / gnyis pa dpon byams bzang pa/ gsum pa dge slong rin chen dpal/ zhes pa sems dpa' chen po ya ma rdzong lung du bzhugs dus phyag phyi rgyun ring du mdzad la/ bzhi pa nam mkha' dpal ldan gyis/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i lcam mo khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras gsum gyi che ba grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ bar pa chos rje shes rab blo gros/ gsum pa dge bsnyen legs pa/ de'i sras rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nyid yin la/ dpon byams bzang gi sras dpon chos mgon/ de'i sras dpon dkon mchog dar/

de'i sras dge bsnyen chos skyong dpal ldan zhes pa byon pa yin no zhes thos shing / sngon rje sems dpa' chen po nyid/ ngor na bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du/ gling skya rgyab ri'i lha brag cog bu'i shar ldebs nas/ rje ga ya dha ra'i bum chu yin zer ba'i chu dkar po zhig brdol nas/ rgya je cher song ste/ mthar rgyal khams thams cad khyab pa rmis gsungs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyis gtam gyi mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /de dag ni sems dpa' chen po nyid byon pa'i rjes thogs su yang / rje grub chen/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje tshul khrims bzang po/ rje 'di nyid de/ tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bu rim par byon nas/ dbus gtsang gi khyon mtha' dag bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gsung ngag rin po che sogs dar rgyas 'byung ba'i rten 'byung kho nar gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas dge bsnyen chos skyong dpal ldan zhes pa rang bzhin gyi dad pa dang ldan zhing / dge ba'i las la ngang gis 'jug pa gsong por smra ba'i ngang tshul can ya rabs dam pa'i tshul las mi 'da' ba zhig byung la/ des bkra shis bzang mo zhes pa ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa'i gos kyis dkris shing / dad pa dang gtong ba'i nor gyis 'byor ba bud med kyi g.yo sgyur spyod pa dang bral la/ thugs kyi gting srab cing zhal cung zad sor ba zhig khab tu bzhes pa las lcags pho rta'i lo la/ 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas bltams par mdzad la/ de'i tshe rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis/ dkon mchog bkra shis zhes mtshan gsol zhing / byin rlabs kyi zil chen pos skyabs 'og tu 'bral med chud par mdzad pa dang / yab yum gnyis kyis kyang byams brtse'i drod kyis gces par bskyangs dbang las ches che ba'i gso skyed dang ldan zhing / mtsho nang gi pad ma ltar gyur pa yin no/

/de ltar sku gzhon nur spyod pa'i skabs nyid nas/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen sogs mkhas grub du ma la byin rlabs yang yang zhu ba dang / klog sogs bslab sbyang gi gnas rnams la yang ngang gis 'jug par mdzad la/ de nas dgung lo dgur phebs pa sa pho stag lo/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i drung gis mkhan po dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i gdung dbon chos rje dkon mchog rin chen pas las slob/ sgra tshad pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas grib tshod/ gzhan yang kha skong du 'os pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes par mdzad de/ mtshan dkon mchog rgya mtshor gsol/ de nas bzung bslab par bya ba'i gnas rnams la skad cig kyang mi 'da' ba'i yid dam brtan po dang bcas/ lo bdun gyi bar/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyi sku dang 'bral med du bzhugs shing / na bza' gsol lhung sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang bla brang nyid nas sgrub par mdzad la/ thugs gnyer phyag dpe sna re 'dzin pa la yang dges dges dang sems 'khrid kyi tshul du rngan pa yang yang gnang ba dang / bar chad bsrung zhing byin rlabs kyis rgyud brlan par mdzad pa'i phyir/ snga dro re bzhin bdud rtsi ril bu re re dang gsol ba'i lhag ma'i/ gsol ras ni rje nyid la tal mar gnang ba sogs/ brtse ldan byams pa'i ma mas bu sdug snying la bcags pa'i tshul gyis skyong ba ltar/ thugs brtse ba gzhal du med pas/ bla lhag tu bskyangs shing / byin gyis rlobs par mdzad pa yin/ zhes thos so/ /de nas rje nyid dgung lo bcu gnyis su phebs pa lcags mo sbrul lo'i dgun chos steng / bdag chen rin po che a tshes pa dang / bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched gling dgar phebs pa nas/

sku mched gsum dang rje 'dis gtsos dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam la gsung ngag rin po che bka' drin bskyangs shing / de nas dgung lo bcu gsum du phebs mtshams rje nyid kyis gtsos grwa ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gis rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis bzung ste/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad dus chen steng / rtsa rgyud la grwa skor dang / sgrigs 'don mdzad pas shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ khyed rnams su lo gzhon pa 'dug gsung ba/ zhal nor ba lta bus 'di rnams kyi nang nas 'am bu rgan pa gda' zhus/ rje btsun nyid bzhad cing / khyod ka rgan pa yod gsung mnyes mnyes mdzad la/ de ni sku tshe'i legs lam rten 'brel mchog tu som nyi dang bral ba yin no/ /de skabs kyang rgya dril bzang po gcig gnang / de nas yang bzhugs gral gcig gi skabs/ rje btsun nyid kyis shin tu dges bzhin nged kyi lag na da lta gser zho lnga bcu yod pa dang / dres gnyis kyi gzhi rten byas rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis sgrigs 'don 'dzugs gsungs/ lug lo tshes pa'i cho 'phrul ngo gang sgrigs 'don 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin no/ /lo de nyid kyi dbyar gsos/ sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs gling khar phebs/ spes kyi chos grwar bzhugs ngos/ gsung chos zhu ba'i thun mtshams rnams su/ rje nyid tshogs pa dang bcas pa la sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bsgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba/ sa lo rang gis mdzad pa'i rje sangs rin gyi bstod pa/ mi nyag grags rdor bas mdzad pa'i chos skyong gi bkra shis kyi lung sogs mang du gsan par mdzad/ de skabs rje dkon mchog rin chen pa'i drung du yang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam rdor/ gur/ rigs bsdus gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang rnams gsan cing / yang skabs shig rje 'dis na mnyam pa'i btsun chung zhig gi zhwa mo chab khang du bskyur bas/

khos kyang rje'i dbu zhwa chab khang du skyur ba la/ rje btsun nyid bdag chen sku mched dang bcas bzhugs pa'i drung du gnas tshul zhus pas/ khyod rang skyug bro na de ma gon/ nga'i zhwa mo 'di gyis gsungs shing / bzhugs gral de kar da lta btsun chung gyag khyer ba gcig 'dug ste/ phugs dgon pa 'di'i bdag byed pa gcig yong gsungs lung bstan gsal por thob cing / thugs gnyer slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo gros mchog ldan pa dang / bde mchog rtsa sngags sogs gsung bsnyen byin rlabs las su rung bar mdzad pa'i dge slong dpal 'byor ba gnyis la yang chos 'brel zhu ba mdzad gsungs la/ de nas dgung lo bcu bzhir phebs pa'i chu mo lug lo/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen nyid thub bstan rnam rgyal du spyan 'dren zhus/ zla ba bzhi tsam bar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras zab rgyas su bka' drin stsal/ slar dbyar gsos gling khar phebs nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin stsal pa yang / do pa nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor gsum gyi khrid tshang ma/ blo sbyong don bdun khrid/ 'gro mgon dpal ye bas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong zin bris kyi lung / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang rnams gsan cing / lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa la/ slar yang bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched gsum gyis gtsos/ tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam la/ gsung ngag rin po che sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor bar mdzad pa rnams kyang ma tshang ba med pa rje 'di nyid kyis gsan par mdzad la/ mdor na rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i drung du snga phyir chos kyi bka' drin thob pa ni/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshar gnyis sogs gsan pa rgya mtshos thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su gang bar mdzad pa ste/ mdor na rje btsun dam pa 'dis chos dang zang zing gnyis ka'i sgo nas bka' drin ji snyed pa dag gis/

gces pa'i bu sdug brtse ldan ma mas skyong ba ji lta ba'i tshul gyis rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pas rgyu mtshan de nyid phyir na/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen nyid/ rje 'di la mchog tu bka' drin che zhing / rje nyid kyang / jo bo gser gling pa'i tshul ltar/ bla ma thams cad kyi nang nas rje btsun nyid snying gi thig ler 'dzin cing / 'bral med gtsug gi nor bu ltar mdzad pa yin la/ da lta'i mdzad pa lkog gyur che phra thams cad kyang / rje btsun nyid la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas lung bstan zhus pas/ de kho na ltar the tshom med pa'i spang blang mdzad de bslu med 'byung ba yin no/ /thugs dam gyi mthil yang gtso bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid la mdzad cing / lo zla dus kyi tshes bcu mchod pa chag med gnang ba'i skabs kyang / gang drin ma dang / sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin ma stong phrag lhag pa chag med du mdzad pa mngon sum du mthong zhing thos pa'i phyir na/ rje 'di nyid ni mnyam rjes thams cad du drin can gyi bla ma'i rnam rol las mi 'da' ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can la dbang 'byor ba gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /zhes yid la nges pa'i shes pa brtan por gyur pa yin no/ /yang der skabs gling khar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi bsnyen pa thim pa zhig mdzad pas/ yi dam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i legs lam gyi mtshan ma brtan po zhig kyang 'byung bar gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /de nas sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen nyid bde ba can du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa yin la/ de'i dgun gling khar/ bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis pas tshogs su gsung ngag rin po che gnang zhing / de'i phyi lo dgung lo bcu drug tu phebs pa/ shing mo byi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la/ bdag chen rin po che gling kha'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol/

de lo rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi phyi rten nang rten sogs bzhengs pa'i phyag las stobs che ba rje nyid kyis kyang khur bzhes su mdzad cing / thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi legs lam la brtson par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i phyi lo dgun yang gsung ngag tshar gcig ste/ mdor na bdag chen rin po che nyid la yang gsung ngag tshar gnyis/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bka' 'bum lung sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi ngom par gsol ba yin no/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs pa me phag shar mtshams/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la/ da rje btsun bla ma dam pa ni mi bzhugs snyam thugs cung zad skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas/ 'di phyogs su bsdad pa la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ thog mar mdo phyogs la slob gnyer blo kha tshims pa gcig byed dgos pa 'dug de yang sngon rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis kyang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i drung du byon 'dug pa dang / grub mtha' yang rje btsun sa skya pa kho na las gzhan dang 'dres med kyi gtsang ma tshun thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs/ de'i dus mkhan thog na/ chos rje rin po che blo gros rab yangs pa dang / khams pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon la/ mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po chos rje bkra shis brtan pa gnyis bzhugs 'dug pa la/ thog mar bsdus pa rtsi ba dang / gzhung rnams 'dzin pa la sogs pa mdzad pas/ spyir yang rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i sku'i dbon yin pas/ kun gyis 'jog che bar yod pa'i steng / thugs rab shin tu phul che bas kun kyang mchog gi gnas su 'dzin pa zhig byung la/ de'i bar skabs rnams su/ mkhan slob gnyis ka la/ gsang sngags kyi chos mang po thob pa yang chos rje rin po che blo gros rab yangs pa'i drung du/ dges pa rdo rje'i rgyu dbang / ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i rjes gnang sogs gsan la/

chos rje bkra shis brtan pa'i drung du/ thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid/ de'i khrid yig shes rab 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i lung / rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i gcod kyi khrid kyi lung / kun rig gzhan phan 'od zer dang / gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi lung / 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang / dmar ser gyi rjes gnang rnams gsan cing / mdo phyogs kyi yon tan phal che ba 'di nyid kyi drung du spyad cing zhus pas/ bla ma 'di yang bka' drin shin tu che ba zhig yin gsungs so/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa sa mo glang lo'i dgun/ thub bstan du grwa tshang gnyis nang zing cung zad kyi rkyen la brten/ rje bkra shis brtan pa dpon slob rnams sa skya phyogs su phebs dgos byung pa la/ de skabs sa skyar/ sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du/ lam 'bras kyi snang gsum la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ slar dpon slob rnams thub bstan du phebs chog pa byung nas/ sngar bzhin thugs gnyer la brtson par mdzad pa'i skabs/ rje rin po che lha mchog seng ge'i drung bka' shog phebs pa nas/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan du byon nas/ spyir du yang bla ma gong ma bka' drin can rnams kyi dam tshig la dgongs/ bla ma tshang ma'i bka' drin shin tu skyong ba'i rgyun kho na yod pa dang / rje de nyid kyis chos dang zang zing gnyis ka'i sgo nas bka' drin zla med mdzad la/ lhag par de skabs/ bdud rtsi ril bu stong rdo gcig dang / sil ma phyed nyis brgya skor dang bcas pa gnang / bzhugs gral thog de kar/ rje nyid bzhengs nas rgyun bzhes kyi sku bem nged la bskyon pa gnang byung ba la/ nged cung zad bag tsha ba dang / 'gom shor dogs gyon ma nus pa la/ rten 'brel gyi gnad ka yod pas gyon gsungs shing / gzhan yang 'di phyi'i legs lam du gyur pa'i bslab bya'i tshogs ji snyed pa yang bka' drin du stsal/ rje 'di nyid la snga phyir dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin thob pa yang /

gsung ngag lam 'bras tshar gnyis/ kye rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang / gshed dmar rdul tshon dang ras bris gnyis ka'i dbang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid yig cha so so'i lung dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phreng ba dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis/ dge legs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'i dbang dang / rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi rjes gnang sogs/ chos dang zang zing gis sgo nas bka' drin zla med pa bskyangs shing / de nas rang lo nyer gsum du phebs pa chu pho 'brug lo dga' ba tshal du/ zla ba lnga dpe mtshams mdzad nas/ dbu ma'i stong thun sogs phyag dpe stobs shin tu che ba thugs la byang bar bzung rjes ngor du phebs pas/ rje lha mchog seng ge'i gsung gis/ gling dgar bdud rtsi ril bu'i gnang sbyin dang mang ja sogs zhu ba la khor tsam phebs dgos byung la/ mus nang so kong po bsam 'grub pa yab yum gyis kyang / kho rang khams nam bzang bar/ gsol chas kyi mthun rkyen yang dag pa sgrub par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas slar yang thub bstan du phebs shing / bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po thub bstan khri thog phebs pa la/ snga mor chos rje bkra shis brtan pa'i drung du zhus pa'i mdo phyogs rnams la nan chags tshul du bskyar nas gsan cing / sngags phyogs gsan pa ni/ gsung ngag lam 'bras tshar gnyis/ lam zab bir srung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid rdo rje 'chang gi kha skong kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig lung dang bcas pa/ de'i brgyud 'debs rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang / mdo bsres klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam gzhag rim pa klu byang gis mdzad pa/ za hor gyi mkhan po shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i gtor chog ar+ya de was mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus rim pa/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba/

slob dpon sgra gcan dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ mgon po gri gug lha lnga'i dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / bir+wa pa'i man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs gnyis bskyed rim gzhung gsum/ lung sbyor bdud rtsi bum pa/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i ṭik+ka theg chen chos rjes mdzad pa/ spros med mdzes rgyan/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig gi lung la sogs pa gsan cing / de'i skabs shig bdag chen rin po che tshe nas thub bstan du phebs pa la yang / phur pa stod las smad las/ gur drag sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nas brgyud pa'i mgon po'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i khrid/ mgon po gri gug lha lnga'i dbang / dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang sogs gsan pa rgya mtshos thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su gang bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo nyer lngar phebs pa shing pho rta lo/ thub bstan du bzhugs skabs/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar po'i snying po la bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum mdzad pas mnal lam tshul du/ rje nyid kyi sku la ral gri btags pa dang / lung pa nags tshal gyis gang ba sogs yi dam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma brtan po brnyes par gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /yang rje nyid thub brtan na bzhugs pa'i skabs gcig mnal lam du bud med bzhi byung nas/ nged kyi mchod gnas la 'gro dgos zer rta sga chas mdzes pa dang bcas pa gcig khrid cing / 'di bskus na mis mi mthong ba yin zer/ thal ba lta bu thum tsam zhig sprad byung ba lus la bskus/ rta la zhon nas thub bstan srang khrod la phyin pas/ sus kyang ma mthong ba'i nyams shig byung shing / de 'phral rta mo gling gong gi bshos bu zhing na sleb 'dug pa la/ sngar gyi bud med de rnams la rgyan cha lugs bzang zhing gur bzhi dang bcas pa 'dug cing /

yang sa skya the re ba gcig na 'dug pa la/ 'di na dang po 'dam skya the re ba bzhi yod pa de yin pa 'dra gsungs pas/ de dus khyed nged kyi mchod gnas su ma song bas yin/ da mchod gnas su song ba dang gur du mthong ba yin/ nged rnams re 'ga' 'dir yang gnas zer zhing / de ma thag bud med bzhi po sems can 'di yin med pa bzhir song nas rje'i sku la rtsed mo mang po zhig byed kyin 'dug mtshams/ mnal sad pas rje nyid cung zad thugs rtog skyes nas/ chos rje thugs rje dpal ba dang mjal dus de ka'i gnas tshul zhib par phul bas/ hai da mus la 'byon dgos pa gda' ba gsungs shing / mgon po'i gtor dbang gcig gnang la/ de dus kyi bud med bzhi ni yab mes kyi bka' srung gdong mo bzhi dregs pa rta mgrin gyi chos srung de yin no/ /de lo bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa thub bstan du phebs/ sdom gsum chos khrir bzhugs nas/ der tshogs kyi skya ser rnams la 'jam dbyangs kyi rje gnang sogs chos mang du gnang zhing / rje nyid la/ sger du g.yu la sogs pa'i zang zing gi gnang sbyin mang po dang / bslab bya'i tshogs kyang brtse bas gnang ste/ slar mus la phebs pa'i phyag phyir dol khang bar byon/ de nas dgung lo nyer drug tu phebs pa'i shing mo lug lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la rje lha mchog seng ge zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la brten/ rje 'dis kyang re zhig e wam̐ chos ldan rang du bzhugs nas dgongs rdzogs skabs phyag phyi dgos pa/ bka' drin rjes dran tshul gyis khur bzhes su mdzad nas/ slar sprel lo mus la phebs/ gling khar rdo rje'i nang mtshams dam mus gshed dmar gyi gzhi bsnyen them pa zhig mdzad nas/ slar yang thub bstan du phebs ngos/ chos kyi rje gnyan chen grags pa blo gros pa'i drung du/ kye rdor bka' srol nag po lugs kyi dbang / gur zhal gyi rjes gnang / sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang /

bde mchog lū nag gi dbang / gsang 'dus skor gsum gyi dbang / chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / phyag na rdo rje 'khor chen/ gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang / tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dbang sogs chos kyi bka' drin mang po gsan par mdzad rjes/ slar yang thub bstan du rje btsun mi g.yo ba la bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum mdzad pas/ lhag pa'i lha nyid zhal gzigs pa'i mthar/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba rje rang la thim pa'i mod la/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams shing / de nas bzung gnyid du ming btags pa tsam las 'od gsal gyi cha de rgyun ldan du yeng med yong ba dang / 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa ji tsam byung yang / sngar gyi 'od gsal las mi 'da' ba'i bde nyams chen po yong ba zhig 'dug gsungs shing / gsung rab kyi tshig don kun la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i blo'i stobs ji cher 'phel ba la brten/ dpyod ldan skye bo ji snyed pa dag 'dus pa'i khrod du/ mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob ste/ kun gyis bsngags pa'i 'os su gyur par snang la/ khyi phag gi lo gnyis kyang / thub bstan rang du bzhugs nas/ mdo sngags kyi thugs gnyer la brtson par mdzad pa la brten/ shes par bya ba'i gnas rnams la ji lta ba'i nges pa brtan po la dbang 'byor pa thob pa yin no/ /de ltar khyi phag gnyis kyi bar thub bstan du bzhugs skabs/ ngor nas dpon slob gnyis char gyi bka' shog sogs 'di byed kyi bslab bya gang yang ma phebs pa la brten/ thugs cung zad chad pa'i rnam pas/ rje rang ngor du phebs lan gcig bla brang gang du yang mi phebs par gnas tshang gcig g.yar sdod dgongs phebs pa dang / srang khar thar rtse nas gsol dpon dang mjal/ nged do nub gnas tshang gcig tu sdod/ sang snga bar phyag 'bul la yong bas/ de ka'i rgyu mtshan 'bul grogs gyis gsungs pa/ rje rin po che sangs rgyas seng ge'i drung du zhus 'dug pas/

da lta rang yar shog gsungs 'bod mi gnang byung ba/ rim pas phebs shing gzim khang sgor cung zad 'gor ba thugs zid kyi ma thub pa lta bus/ rje nyid bar khang sgor phebs/ gnas tshang btsal bas ci byed/ thal mar mi yong ba gsungs cung zad bka' skyon gyi rnam pa phebs kyin 'dug pa la/ rje 'dis kyang thal mar yong los 'dod de/ rje lha mchog seng ge gshegs man/ lo gnyis kyi bar/ yi ge na gcig gi bslab bya yang ma phebs pas bka' drin mi skyong ba yin nam snyam/ sems yang 'pham po byung lags/ zhes sogs yus pa'i tshul du zhus pas/ rje nyid kyang thugs zhi ba chen pos dges tshul mdzad/ de nas rje rin po che dkon mchog lhun grub drung du byin rlabs zhu ba tsam mdzad nas/ thar pa rtse rang du mtshams dam pa'i tshul gyis rgyun ring tsam bzhugs kyang / bla brang ma nas gang gi yang bslab cha sogs ma byung ba nas/ thugs yid chad pa'i rnam pa byung zhing / der skabs gling khar bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa'i drung sku gshegs 'dug pa nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i drung dgongs pa zur pa zhig gi gtad so la brten/ rje 'di nyid gling gar 'gro dgos gsungs phebs rtsis kyi khres po sogs grabs byas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub drung du phyag 'bul la/ chos brda dang stabs bstun myur bar phebs pas/ rje nyid dang sgor mjal/ phyag 'bul zhus pas gar 'gro gsungs pa la/ bdag mus la 'gro rtsis kyi do nub bye spor sleb pa 'gro lags zhus pas/ kha sang nas nged tsho yang chos smrar po zhig gis g.yengs pa dang / khyed kyang dpe mtshams dam po 'dug pa nas 'phrad ma thub/ dum tsam 'then gyis/ nged da lta sleb yong gsungs/ tshogs su phebs/ dum tsam thar pa rtser byon pas/ gsung chos 'phral la grol ba'i 'bod mi gnang byung 'phral phyin pas/ gzim chung na rje nyid sku rkyang du bzhugs 'dug pa/ kha sang nas nged rang gnyis ka chos dang dpe mtshams stabs 'phrad thub pa zhig ma byung /

nged rang yid la khyed brtse lhang lhang du yod pa de ka ma gtogs/ sems la 'khu 'khrig rdul tsam yang med/ nged la tshe 'di phyir bka' drin che zhing / blo brtse gtad mtshams rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen yin/ bla ma'i dam tshig la bsams kyang / chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka'i khul nas/ khyed la phan thogs pa zhig byed snyam pa med ri gsungs dbu snyung gnang byung bas/ de ma thag lus sbrid 'gro ba lta bu'i zil dang / ba spu g.yo zhing dga' ba dang skyo ba zung sbrel du byung la/ de nas bzung rje nyid kyis kyang thugs brtse ba chen pos skad cig kyang 'dor ba med par bka' drin gyis bskyangs shing / nged rang yang kha tshig tsam ma yin pa'i mos gus rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa bla lhag tu yod la/ bka' drin gyi sgo nas kyang rje 'di rang che ba yin te/ snga mor chos kyi rgyal po nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje'i drung gis khyed kyis gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshar du thob gsungs pa la/ bdag gis dbus gtsang la grags pa'i lam 'bras tshar bcu gnyis dang / rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsung ngag rin po che cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa tshar gcig ste/ bcu gsum thob zhus pa'i/ phyi ma yang rje 'di nyid kyi bka' kho na las byung bar mngon no/ /de nas dgung lo so gcig tu phebs pa/ lcags pho byi lo/ rje 'di'i dgongs pa la/ thub pa bka' drin can gyi bstan pa la zhugs la ma rdzogs pa ni/ bdag gis bgyi ba ma yin gyis/ de bas na dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhig bslangs la/ dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi gnad rnams la nges shes brtan po dang bcas mig 'bras ltar gces par 'dzin pa zhig gtan bya'i gtso bor 'dug pas/ de bzhin bgyi'o snyam/ lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ 'khon sa skya pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mkhan po sde snod 'dzin pa chen po/

bkra shis brtan pas las kyi slob dpon/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bsod nams bkra shis gsang ston/ slob dpon kun bzang pas grib tshod pa/ gzhan yang kha skong du 'os pa'i dge slong rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang du bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad de/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos pa'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa chen por bzhugs pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /lo de'i ston mus la phebs shing / thos bsam gyi gnas rnams la nan chags mdzad ngos/ slar glang lo thub bstan du phebs pa'i skabs shig dgongs pa la/ da ni grwa tshang dang bstan pa spyi dgos kyi zhabs tog la dmigs nas/ po ti mang rab la grwa skor gcig legs pa 'dug dgongs/ de yang thog mar bar chad sel ba'i lha yin pas/ gshed dmar gyi bsnyen pa la 'jug pa mdzad/ grol mtshams/ snga 'gros ngor du khor tsam phebs pa'i rje rin po che dkon mchog lhun grub drung du de ka'i gnas tshul zhib rgyas phul bas/ dges pa'i gsung gis de ka legs 'dug drin can gyi bla ma gong ma'i thugs dgongs kyang de kas rdzogs/ nged tsho yang blo kha tshim pa yin gsungs pa sogs mnyes pa'i bka' bstsal dang / grwa skor gyi yo byad/ sku chos gos legs pa gcig gis 'go byas/ na bza'i sna grangs bzhi/ ja gos dar/ g.yu mang po sogs gnang sbyin mdzad cing / de dang khyud mthun rje sangs rgyas seng ge pas kyang / mkho ba'i yo byad bka' drin bskyangs 'tshams/ dgung lo sum cu so gsum du phebs pa/ chu pho stag lo hor zla drug pa la/ dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ phar tshad dbu sdom 'dul mngon sogs po ti bco brgyad la grwa skor mdzad pas/ gsung rab kyi don dpyid phyin par longs pa'i bshad sgros dang / rigs pa'i spu rigs phyed pa'i sgo nas lung gi rgyab rten rdzogs par 'dren pa'i stana~X pa sogs la/

dpyod ldan kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa'i bsngags 'os phul du phyin par gyur pa yin zhing / de skabs gnyan chen grags pa blo gros pas kyang thugs mnyes pa'i sgo nas gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad la/ de dus lha sa rdzong na/ chos rje byams pa shes rab pa bzhugs pa'i drung du/ chos skyong zhal bzhi pa dang / mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang yang gsan ngos/ rim pas ngam ring du/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje'i drung du phebs/ der bzhugs gral du gser mdog can gyi rab 'byams pa dpal rin zer ba'i yon tan can du byed pa gcig dang 'bel gtam mdzad pas/ lung rigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la/ mchod yar rgyas par mdzad pas/ sde bdag chen po yang thugs mnyes pa'i sgo nas bslab bya'i tshogs mang po mdzad cing / mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis kyang tshim pa thob ste/ slar yang chu mo yos lo e wam̐ chos ldan du 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi drung du phebs pa dang dus mtshungs/ sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dpon slob mang po yang phebs pa'i de lo gsung chos gang gsung tshang ma gnang ba'i dgongs pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ da lan byon pa legs gsungs/ dges dges mdzad cing 'dug pa la/ bdag gis na ning sa skya'i grwa skor grub nas ngam ring du phyin pas/ chos rgyal chen po'i bka' lung gi dbyar chos byin grol 'dug kyang / da dung bshad pa zhag gsum bzhi tsam yong ba 'dug pas/ chos sde chen por grwa skor byas pa legs tshul phebs kyin 'dug pa la/ bdag gis da lan dbyar chos grol 'dug pa nas dgongs grol zhus/ sang phod grwa skor la cis kyang yong lags zer ba zhus yod pa lags pas/ da lan dbyar chos la ngam ring chos sde chen por grwa skor la 'gro rtsis yin lags zhus pas/

rje nyid kyang shin tu dges pa'i tshul gyis/ 'o na de ka legs pa 'dug gsung chos thams cad khyed rang gi blo la gang yod rjes su phul bas chog gsungs/ dges pa'i bka' stsal dang bcas/ dpal ngam ring chos sde chen por phebs pas/ de lo phyogs kyi grwa skor ba stobs shin tu che ba 'dug pa'i nang nas/ rje nyid mkhyen pa'i rlabs che bas gzhung mtha' dag tshig byang zhing don lhong che ba byung ba la brten/ mkhas par grags pa mtha' dag ngo mtshar du 'dzin cing bstod bkur gyi yul dam par gyur pa'i sgo nas/ snyan par grags pa'i gtam gyis dpyod ldan yid mgu bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo so lngar phebs pa shing pho 'brug lo e wam̐ chos ldan du byon/ zla ba bdun bar ma chad du bzhugs nas/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mda' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog lhun grub drung du/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bka' mtha' yas pa zhig gsan par mdzad do/ /de nas shing mo sbrul lo gling khar phebs sngags kyi thugs gnyer la nan chags skabs/ mus gnas gsar nas chos rje sangs rgyas bshes gnyen pas gtsos grwa pa mang po zhig byams chos lnga 'dzin pa'i slob dpon du nan zhus dang / lhag par rje dkon mchog lhun grub drung gis kyang / de bzhin legs tshul phebs pa nas/ dgun sle lung chos sder byon nas byams chos 'grel pa dang bcas slob pa gnang / de'i phyi lo dgung lo so bdun du phebs pa me pho rta la/ dpal ldan sa skya yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su dbyar chos steng phebs par mdzad la/ de lo char shin tu dkon pa'i 'ga' rong chos sde/ 'jad sogs byams chos pa snga ma rnams grwa skor mdzad pa nam mkha' g.ya' bcad pa lta bu yod skabs/ rje'i zhal nas khong tsho dang nged mi 'dra/ nged bshad pa byed dus char pa yong gsungs zhal pho cung zad dang bcas/ rje nyid bzhengs te bshad pa 'dzugs par brtsam ma thag chos 'khor lhun po'i phyogs nas glo bur sprin skyes te char pa nyin mtshan sbrags nas babs pas/

sa skya'i skya ser rnams dga' nas/ da lan gyi char 'di rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dbon po'i byin rlabs yin zer ngo mtshar du byed pa byung zhing / de skabs bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen drung byas 'gyur na bzhugs 'dug par/ dpon slob rags bsdus kyis mjal bar phebs/ slar rim pas ngam ring du phebs/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po dang mjal/ bzhugs gral der jo gdan rin 'byor ba bya ba'i dbus gtsang na mkhas grags chen po yod pa zhig dang 'bel gtam mdzad pas lung rigs gnyis kas rje nyid rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob ste lan gyi spobs pa dang bral bar mdzad pa dang / grwa pa rnams kyi byams chos bsgrigs 'don gsal dag snyan gsum dang 'brel bar byung bas/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po nyid thugs lhag par mnyes pa'i sgo nas/ sngar yan mdo phyogs la slob gnyer blo kha tshim pa byung 'dug pas legs/ da ni sngags phyogs la slob gnyer mthil phyin pa gcig byas/ mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi dge bshes rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gdan sa zin nges gcig byed dgos/ da dus kyis ma khyogs pas bstan pa yongs rdzogs la bslab sbyangs mthil phyin byed mkhan yang dkon pa 'dug khyed lta bu bla ma dam pa'i dbon po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin/ re chen po yod pas khur chen po byed dgos/ 'di tso nas kyang sems yul bcags pa'i mgo 'don du gang 'gro cis kyang byed snyam pa yod pas/ thugs la zhog gsung ba sogs bslab bya'i gnas mtha' dag dang / zang zing rnyed pa'i sgo nas kyang gnang sbyin bla na med pa stsal nas/ rim pas mus la phebs/ shar res sman sdings su/ rje lo chen drung du mjal bas rje'i zhal nas/ khyed bla ma dam pa'i dbon po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin zhing re chen po yang yod/ bstan pa la khur chen po bzhes dgos/ mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer de ka tsam gyis chog la/ da dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rgyud gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags phyogs la thugs gnyer rgya che ba zhig mdzod/

bstan pa dang sems can la yang de ka phan zhing / khyed rang gi phugs thes su yang de ka che bas thugs khur mdzad dgos gsungs pa sogs thugs kyi gting nas bzhar ba'i bka' stsal lhug par phebs pa la brten/ rje 'di'i thugs la yang 'thad par byung zhing / de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom lung zhig zhus te byon la/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsung las/ rje btsun lo chen de skyes bu khyad par can gcig yin pa gdon mi za ste/ khong dang nam mjal res kyis rang la byed 'dod kyi blo bcos ma yin pa dung dung pa nges pa skye yi 'dug ces gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de lo'i mjug tu rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs kyis bde mchog nag po pa'i gsung bsnyen dang lam 'bras tshar gsum gsungs pa'i gnas phu mda' sum mdor sku mtshams bcad de/ dag ljon spyi gsum gzhung bshad dmar ma/ bdag med bstod 'grel sogs thugs la bya bar bzung nas/ lug lo zla ba bdun pa la/ ngam ring du chos rgyal chen po'i drung du rgyugs phul bas shin tu mnyes par mdzad de/ gsol chas kyang / mus sdud chen steng nas/ nas lcags kha'i khal zhe brgyad re khags bcogs su gnang / de nas ston po thub bstan dang ngor du phebs/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub dang mjal/ lo chen gyis bka' lung phebs tshul dang / phyag dpe'i rgyugs phul tshul sogs zhus pas/ rje nyid shin tu mnyes pa'i tshul gyis/ lo chen gyi thugs la de bzhin shar ba/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi thugs rjes khong pa'i rgyud bskul ba yin/ sa skya pa rang lugs la mi dgos kha med kyi gzhung yin pas/ bzung ba legs 'dug gsungs dges dges rang mdzad cing / slar yang gling khar phebs/ dgung lo so dgur phebs pa sa pho sprel lo hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu la/ dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams bcad de/ tshes bcu nas nyer gcig gi bar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gtso bor stana~X pa'i bsags sbyangs mdzad de nas grangs bzung ste/

dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags 'bum phrag lnga/ yum la yang de bzhin dang / 'khor rnams la khri tsho lnga re/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ bya lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nang tshun la mthar phyin par mdzad la/ de'i skabs mnal lam du/ rdzong chen po gcig gi rtse na/ rje nyid 'khor bcas bzhugs/ de'i lho phyogs thams cad khang zhing stobs che ba dang / byang gi phyogs na 'brog sde shin tu che ba 'dug pa'i zhal bdag mdzad pa'i nyams shig byung ba ni/ da lta bod 'brog kun gyi mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ bya lo dgun rje rin po che nam mkha' dbang phyug pa'i drung du lam 'bras cha tshang gdams ngag so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa dang kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa bde mchog gi rgyud man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa sogs chos bka' mang du gsan cing / rje'i zhal nas dgon pa 'dir slob gnyer gyi rgyun bzang po gcig tshugs pa'i grogs ldan mdzod gsungs pa bzhin/ dang du bzhes nas slob dpon mdzad/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i chog khrid bshad pa sogs grwa pa rang rang gi blo tshod dang sbyar nas rim gyis 'khrid par mdzad pas thams cad la blo bskyed shin tu che bar byung ba yin no/ /de nas bzung / da lta bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud ṭīk+ka dang bcas pa/ dag ljon spyi gsum sogs la slob gnyer rgyun bzang po yod pa rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin no/ /de nas lcags pho khyi lo kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud rnams thugs la byang bar bzung ste/ sngar bzhin rgyugs phul/ bstan pa spyi dgos kyi rgyun la phan pa'i spyan ltos bzang po 'jog par mdzad/ de lo yum bsnyung ba la brtse bas brlan pa'i bsnyung g.yog drod la sbyar ba mdzad kyang / ma phan par gshegs pa la/

rjes sgrub dgongs rdzogs rnams sdig dang ma 'dres pa sgrub par mdzad de/ bka' drin gyi cha bsab par mdzad cing / de nas rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas pa'i drung du/ blo sbyong dang / gcod khrid/ mdog lho mkhan chen drung du/ do pa legs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i spyod khrid kyi lung gsan par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas dgung lo zhe gnyis su phebs pa lcags mo phag la gling khar/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba sogs gzigs rtog mdzad bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs/ rje rin po che nam mkha' dbang phyug pas sku chos legs pa gcig dang / sku 'dab gcig gnang nas/ dgon pa 'di'i chos khrims lo gcig mdzad dgos/ sgrigs gang sa nas khyad che ba gda' gsungs pa dang bzhes mdzad/ rta mo lung pa'i skya ser thams cad la khrims snyom pa/ dge 'dun thams cad thugs gnyer gyi grwa tshugs pa/ dgon par 'bul ba byung ba rnams 'ga' zhig gis sha rin la bcal nas khye nyos byed pa sogs mig ltos ngan pa bkag pa'i rgyun bzang po da lta yang yod la/ de nas byi lo zla ba la brgyad pa la chos khrims 'phrod par mdzad nas/ glang lo dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams bcad rgya dam pa mdzad de/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / kun rig gi rnam bshad mang po gcig gzigs skabs/ gegs kyi rnam pas cung zad snyung du byung ba la/ der 'dzin med pa'i ngang nas/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ nad kyi ngo bo med par bde stong zung 'jug tu chams 'gro ba zhig byung la/ de'i rgyun da lta yang yod gsungs shing / stag lo'i gzhug tu mtha' gong du phebs/ mkhan chen rin po che rdo rje rin chen pa'i drung du nai gu chos drug gi khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ sems 'chi med nyams khrid du bskyangs nas/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gis thog grangs/ nai gu'i chos skor tshang ma zhus shing / nyams len la gnad du bsnun pa la/

de dag rang rang skabs thob kyi nyams bzang po shar cing / khyad par rmi lam skabs gcig gling skya na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ sems can 'jigs pa zhig gis ded byung ba/ rjes nam mkha' la 'phur byon pas gtsang po dmar ya 'chos 'dug pa'i pha rir/ rdor bzang sle ru babs pas/ sku 'khris na sa skya phyogs kyi grwa pa bstan dar zer ba zhig 'dug pa la/ ngas snang ba bden med du rtogs pa 'di rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi sku drin yin/ khyod rang nga'i lag pa la so thob dang / nga la tsha rgyu med gsungs pa'i nyams gcig dang / yang sems can de 'dra ba gcig gis ded pas/ dgon pa'i steng gi nam mkha' mthon por 'phur ba rmis gsungs pa sogs/ mdor na khrid thams cad ming rkyang tsam du ma zad pa thad so thad so'i nyams rgyud la skyes skyes nan tan dang brtson pa drag pos 'jur la theb par mdzad pa yin pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ rje dbon la nyams 'di 'dra skyes 'dug gsungs/ dges pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod kyang mdzad la/ gzhan yang ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang la sogs pa shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor rnams nan bcags mtha' gcod dang / nyams len la yang rtag 'grus su mdzad pas thad so'i myong ba gdeng dang ldan par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas stag yos mtshams/ dpon slob lngas dpal e wam̐ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog lhun grub drung du phebs shing de'i dgun gsung ngag lam 'bras rgyas pa yig cha so so'i lung dang bcas pa gnang skabs rje'i zhal nas/ da lo lam 'bras la zin thun gcig dgos pa 'dug pas skyor mgo mdzod gsungs pa la/ bdag gis skyor mgo mi yong lags sam zhus pas/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan tshogs chen du skyor mgo byed pa la bskal pa dpag med nas tshogs chen po bsag dgos da lan cis kyang mdzod gsungs nan gyis phebs nas/ rje 'dis kyang gsung ngag gi zur tsam yang ma nyams par thogs med du bskyar cing /

zin thun khog phub kyi yig cha shin tu bzang ba da lta yang yod do/ /de nas yos lo rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i drung du/ bde mchog bong zhal can/ lū dril gnyis/ mahā ma ya/ kye rdor ḍom+bi lugs/ kun rig gi dbang / dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi khrid/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'bum gter dang rigs gsum mgon po'i bca' thabs/ rje sems dpa' chen po dang / rje sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis kyi bka' 'bum lung la sogs zab rgyas kyi chos sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan la/ de dag kyang ming rkyang tsam ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes 'them par mdzad cing / de'i dbyar rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub drung du/ 'bras yul skyed tshal nas/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer dpon slob mang po phebs nas/ gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rje nyid kyang phyag phyir dkri ba'i ngos/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe khrid/ rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ dpyal a mo gha'i khrid yig gzhan gnyis gsal byed sa los mdzad pa/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid rje btsun dang kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i yig lung / rtsa dbu ma dang dril bu rim lnga'i khrid rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i yig lung dang bcas pa/ dpyid kyi thig le'i khrid rnams dang / lung gi skor la bhū ri ba'i rgyun bshags/ shar pa dang dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ he ru ka'i byung tshul/ rje btsun dang kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum/ nag po gzhung drug sa chen gyi nag 'bum dang / rnal 'byor ma'i skor gnyan gyi 'bru 'bum/ rje btsun gyi don 'brel dang bcas pa/ nag po bshad sbyar/ nag po dkyil chog 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i lū nag gi mngon rtogs/ de'i sbyin sreg rje rang gi bka' 'bum tshang ma/ 'jigs byed rwa spod kyi lung rnams dang /

bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma/ gdong drug ro langs brgyad bskor rnams kyi dbang gi sgo nas kyang / thugs kyi re ba yongs su gang bar mdzad cing / de skabs rje'i gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i bde mchog spyi bshad kyang yod do/ /rje 'di nyid la kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer gyis 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang / dbu ma rtsa shes/ bshes springs/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum/ sher phyin brgyad stong pa/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa phun tshogs so thar ma rnams kyi lung dges pa chen pos stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo zhe bdun du phebs pa/ me pho 'brug lo rje 'di'i dgongs pa la/ da ni lan cig dbus phyogs la phyin/ lha sar jo shāka rnam gnyis mjal ba dang / yongs 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig dang mjal bas 'dod chos 'dra zhu zhing / lhag par lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa de nyid thar lam ston pa'i yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog tu gdon mi za bar dgongs/ bla ma dam pa 'tshol ba la/ nam yang ngom pa med pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang lta bu'i dad 'dun rtse gcig pas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub drung du/ gyib pa'i tshul gyi dgongs grol zhus skabs snar thang nas/ rje rin po che spyan 'dren zhu yin 'dug pa'i mchod rten bar gyi phyag phyir rje 'dis kyang phebs nas phyag 'bul dang byin rlabs zhus/ bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam yid tshim pa 'debs pa mdzad pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ 'o na khyed dpon slob rnams 'byon lam bde ngos/ yar phyogs gang myur phebs pa mdzod gsungs shing / phyi mig yang yang gzigs shing 'dug pa/ nged kyis kyang / rje nyid la yang yang bltas/ sems kyi lhag ma lus pa zhig byung ba de nged dpon slob tshe 'dir mi mjal ba la lta ba 'dug gsungs shing / de nas rje 'di dpon slob 'bras yul skyed tshal du phebs ngos/

kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer dang mjal/ der sne len bzang po mdzad cing zhag shas ngal sor bzhugs/ de nas rim pas chos 'khor lha sar byon/ zhag bco brgyad tsam bzhugs ngos/ jo shag rnam gnyis kyis gtsos/ rten mjal zhib par mdzad cing / lhag par jo shag drung du bstan 'gro la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen 'debs shing bzhugs pa'i skabs shig spyan snga rin po che nyid lo'i gzim chung lcang lo can na sku mtshams su bzhugs yod pa la/ nye gnas kyis gzim chung sgor phyin pas/ gsung bgros di ri ri 'dug pa nas/ nang du phyin sku mdun du su byung lags zhus pas/ su yang med/ phal cher rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dbon po de bka' srung rnams kyis gdan drangs yong gin yod pa 'dra gsung ba byung 'dug la/ de nas ma 'gyangs par rje dpon slob rnams kyis chos 'khor lha sa nas bteg ste rim pas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la/ dbur stod la dgon par spyan snga rin po che nyid kyi drung du phebs/ mjal ma thag dad pas drangs pa'i ba spu g.yo zhing sangs rgyas lta bu'i mos pa bla lhag tu skyes/ gling kha ngor sogs gsung 'phros rgyang tsam byung ba'i mthar/ bdag da lam lha sa sogs zhar byung ma gtogs rje nyid kyi drung du 'dod chos 'dra zhu bar ched gtad yin lags pas bka' drin bskyangs dgos tshul sogs zhib par zhus pas/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir yang dbus gtsang thag ring lam gyi dka' tshegs la ma gzigs par/ chos don gnyer gyi phebs lugs ngo mtshar che zhing / lhag par dam tshig gcig pa'i gnad la thugs kyi 'dun pa gtad nas 'dir phebs pa bka' drin bskyangs/ gsung chos cha spyi babs kyang don du gnyer ba byung na tshang ma sgyid lug med pa'i gang yong byed bsam pa de ka yod cing / khyad par nged kyi snying phur 'cha' sa/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen yin/ khyed 'dir 'byon pa yang / khong gi thugs rje dang /

chos skyong gis spyan drangs pa yin snyam pa yod/ chos de rang la gang yod cis kyang 'bul gsungs dges pa'i ngang nas zla ba de'i tshes bco brgyad la nai gu 'dzugs pa gnang zhing / thog mar nai gu ma nas brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun gyi rnam thar nas bzung / nai gu'i dbang byin rlabs/ khrid man ngag gi skor so so'i yig lung gi skor sogs yongs su rdzogs pa rje spyan snga rin po che nyid kyis mkhas grub byams pa chos nyi ma la gang gsan tshang ma bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis bka' drin bskyangs shing / bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin la/ de dag kyang ming tsam ma yin pa nyams len la rtag 'grus su mdzad pas myong ba khyad par can 'khrungs la/ rmi lam gyi skabs gcig spyan snga rin po che'i drung du byon skabs/ dpon slob nyung bsdus rang zhig gi dus/ rmi lam la bogs thon po byung ngam gsungs pa la/ rje 'dis sngon mtha' gong du rmi lam zin po byung na'ang / sprul bsgyur cher mi thub yod lags te/ deng sang sprul bsgyur dga' rab yong gin 'dug lags zhus pa'i 'phros la brten/ spyan snga rin po ches sprul bsgyur mdzad pa'i rnam par rgyas pa zhig gsungs byung / nged la de rigs mang po byung ste/ brjed 'dug gsungs gab pa'i tshul gyis gsal po mi gnang la sku zil che bas zhu yang ma spobs/ thor chags ni seb tshags su yang gsal la/ 'od gsal 'di nged gzhon dus slob gnyer byed skabs nas bzung gsal po rang yong pa zhig yod gsungs pa thos so/ /de nas lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ lo dgon pa 'di sprul pa'i sku mched gsum gyi ya gyal/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang sems mchog gis thugs rgyud phyug pa spyan snga rin po che tshul khrims 'bar gyis 'debs pa mdzad/ byang rwa sgreng gi dod lo ba gcig byung gsungs pas/ ming yang lo dgon par grags pa'i go sa chen por byed pa yin zhing /

nged rang rnams sems chung byed na ma gtogs/ gdan sa che che mo gang la yang ltos mi dgos pa'i bka' gdams kyi grwa pa khungs ma rang yin pas/ dgon pa 'di'i zhal bdag mdzad/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas skyong thar phan thogs su 'gyur ba'i thugs khur cis kyang bzhes dgos/ des rang gzhan yongs la phan zhing / nged rgan po'i blo kha rdzogs pa yin/ zhes sogs zhal lta mang du gnang gi 'dug pa la/ bdag gtsang nas yong dus byang chos rgyal chen pos/ khyed da lan dbus su byon la/ dpal ldan sa skya pa gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos gsan rgya gang che ngos slar 'di phyogs su gang myur sleb pa mdzod/ dgag dgos gal che ba yongs shas che gsungs pa bdog pas/ sde bdag sku drin can yin pa tshun/ yar phyogs nas 'bod mi byung na 'gro dgos pa mod lags sam zhus pas/ rje spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ de bzhin gsungs pa byung na/ nged kyang de ka 'dod pas/ 'byon pa las 'os med cing yong gsungs pa phebs/ de nas spyan snga rin po che'i dgongs pa 'khrid phyir bka' lung dang du bzhes nas/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gcig la/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi zhabs stegs nor bu'i khri la/ rje nyid mngon par dbang bskur cing / lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol/ spyan snga rin po che nyid dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su phebs/ lhag gnas kyi me tog bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol tshul du rgyas par mdzad de/ chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i go 'phang mchog la 'god par mdzad/ mkho ba'i yo byad dag bla brang nas khur bzhes dang / de'i nyin yang bla brang nas gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad la/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho skye bo'i tshogs ji snyed pa dang bcas pas kyang / 'bul ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i tshe rje 'dis kyang bka' gdams lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i yas gtam dang /

bsngo ba shin tu rgyas pa snyan zhing 'jebs pa gtam rgyud kyis spras shing / skabs thob dang sbyar ba'i lung so sos kyang mdzes par byas pa/ spobs pa'i khyad par zad mi shes pa dang / gsung gi gsang mthon po'i sgo nas 'gal 'khrul bzlos pa sogs kyi skyon gang yang med pa 'dom par mdzad pas/ spyan snga rin po che nyid gtso bor bzhugs pa'i der 'dus kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dges pa mchog tu bskyed par mdzad cing / mtha' dag kyang thar pa bla na med pa'i legs byas la mngon par 'du mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas skabs shig chos mdzad pa'i snying po/ byang chos rgyal chen po dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis kyi drung du brdzangs pa 'khor/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bka' shog bslab bya phebs pa la/ spyir chos la 'dod che ba'i tshol lugs dgos pa gzhir bzhag lhag par rje spyan snga ba de nyid gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs la/ skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mkhas la thugs dkyil che zhing / thugs rje che ba yod 'dug pa snga phyir dgongs 'khrid thabs mkhas kyis 'dod chos zhu lugs srid bsrings bsrings pa byed dgos shing / khyad par nged rang ngor pa rang lugs kyi chos bka' ji snyed pa dag la/ brgyud pa'i bka' srol lhad med khungs thub yid ches kyi gnas su yod pas/ de ka ltar mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten lugs byed pa dang / bstan pa'i khur khyer ba'i lhag bsam ci nas kyang mdzod cig nged khyed la snying nas brtse lhang lhang de ka yod kyang / sa thag gi 'gal bas mjal thub pa dka' ba 'dug na'ang byang chub bar du mi 'bral lags/ khyed sku tshe rgyas pa'i ched dur ba/ mnga' thang rgyas pa'i ched li khri/ bgegs zhi ba'i phyed yungs kar/ snyan grags chen po 'byung ba'i phyir dung dkar/ bkra shis kyi legs lam mchog rten 'brel du bskur ba yin gsungs pa sogs bslab bya'i tshogs ji snyed phebs shing /

nged kyang dpon slob gyes yong skabs 'bral mi phod pa'i sems shin tu 'phreng ba gcig byung ba'i rgyu dang / bka' shog de kas nyer lan gyi rkyen byas sems dga' ba dang skyo ba gnyis ka'i ngang nas/ bla ma dran zhing mjal 'dod kyi sems 'dod gdung che ba rang zhig byung yang / sa thag bskal ba sogs 'phral du mjal mi thub pa 'dug ci myur zhabs drung du slebs pa byed snyam da dung yod pa/ skye dgu'i bsod nams ma yin pa'i las nye bar smin pa lta bus lo de nyid kyi zla ba dgu pa'i nyer gcig la/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan 'dug pa la/ spyir yang nged sems rtsa srab pa dang / lhag par lus stod la nad ro'i cha thu ba zhig yod pa'i stabs/ spyan snga rin po ches gtsos tshang mas bka' 'gros byas nged la gsang sgo bsdams pas lo gcig bar gtan nas ma tshor bas mjal 'dod sems kyi lhag mar lus pa zhig byung ces gsungs par grags so/ /de nas dgung lo nga gcig tu phebs pa sa pho sprel lo zla ba gsum pa yan/ lo dgon pa dang bya yul gnyis la re mos kyis phebs shing gdul bya rnams la/ rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos bka' rgya chen po mdzad cing / skya ser du gtogs pa thams cad la spyan snga rin po che'i gnang sgo las skad cig kyang ma g.yos pa'i skyong thar mdzad/ de skabs kyang spyan snga rin po che'i drung du/ bde mchog nag po pa/ dril bu phyi dkyil/ spyan ras gzigs lha mang / sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ de'i lus dkyil nyer lnga ma/ rnam 'joms ma ṇi badz+ra/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga/ a ra pa tsa lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / rgyu lam/ gur/ bdag med ma/ thig le'i dbang khrid/ grub chen brgyad bcu'i byin rlabs/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi byin rlabs/ lung khrid kyi bshad pa/ grub rgyal ma'i dbang khrid dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med dze ta ri/ kun rig rnams kyi dbang dang / rme brtsegs ljang sngon gyi rjes gnang khrus chog dang bcas pa/

dzam dmar srog sgrub/ dzam dmar phyag drug pa/ dzam lha dkar po/ seng gdong sngon mo/ seng gdong dmar mo/ dzam ser nag mgon po gri gug lha lnga/ chos skyong am̐ gho ra/ nam mkha'i gos can ma/ dud gsol lha mo rnams kyi rjes gnang / de dag so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa/ su kha chos drug gi khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ chos skyong gi skor me 'bar ma'i nang bzhin dang / der ma mthus pa spyan snga rin po che'i gsan yig nang bzhin/ mgon po'i nang khrid/ gri gug lha lnga'i dbang / lha brgyad kyi dbang / bcu gnyis ma'i dbang / gur lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / bran bdud yab yum gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ bka' gdams thor bu rnam grangs mang po sangs rgyas blo gros kyis bsgrigs pa/ jo bo chen po'i rnam thar che chung / bka' gdams pa'i gtor ma cha drug gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phangs pa'i lung / yas gtam gyi lung / bstan rim sogs mang du gsan pas thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par mdzad la/ spyan snga rin po che'i gsung las kyang / nai gu bka' gdams sogs chos bka' nged rang la gang yod rnams/ gser ga bdag po'i tshul du tshang ma khyed rang la 'phrod pas sems bde/ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi dbang de 'bul dgos pa yod gsungs pa de skabs phyag thog ma long par lus pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas lug lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la gling gar/ chos rje nam mkha' dbang phyug pa'i drung zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la brten/ byang nas chos rgyal chen po kun dga' rin chen drung gi dpon slob gnyis char du zhu shog rten dang bcas yar phyogs phebs dgos pa'i nan chags la brten/ sprel lo tshes bstun phebs par zhal gyis bzhes ngos zhu yig dang bcas mi sna yar phyogs brdzangs/ re zhig bar spyan snga rin po che'i dgongs pa khrid/ dgon pa'i 'dzin bkod sogs lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i zhib cha dgos pa rnams chug med kyi ring nas slar yang spyan snga rin po che'i drung du/

chos kyi dka' gnad rnams la nan chags kyis dogs dpyod dang phyag len phra mo tshun chad la the tshom gyi dri ma med pa'i mtha' chod zhus te/ yar phyogs 'byon par nye ba'i skabs spyan snga rin po che'i drung gis/ 'di phyir dge ba'i bslab bya'i tshogs ji snyed pa dag ma bu dung can gyi bu gcig pa la brtse bas 'dom pa ltar/ thugs nas bzhar ba'i bslab bya dang / chibs pa bzang po gcig gis mgo byas zang zing gi dngos po'i gnang sbyin bsam las 'das pas kyang yid tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas spyan snga rin po che'i drung du gus pas phyi phyag phul/ 'di phyi'i legs lam phun sum tshogs pa'i smon lam dang / 'gyang med du mjal ba'i smon lam zhus te/ lo dgon pa nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ stod lung dang snye mo'i phu bcad nas byon pas bka' srung 'phreng ba'i rnam pas/ gangs shin tu che ba babs lam yang mi rnyed pa lta bu byung bas stabs phyag phyi ba rnams 'o brgyal gyi rnam pa yang 'dug pa nas/ rje 'dis bla ma mchog gsum la gsol 'debs dang / bka' srung la bden pa brdar bas/ gangs chad cing nyi ma yang dron po shar bas dpon slob thams cad nyes pa'i skyon med par en tsa kha'i phur phebs la snga mor lor bzhugs skabs/ bud med rgyan bzang po dang bcas pa gcig phyag phyir 'brang ba'i mtshan lam byung ba yang / bka' gdams srung ma nam mkha'i gos can 'di yin zhing / 'dis snga phyir rje nyid kyi 'phrin las gang dgos bsgrubs la/ rje 'dis kyang thugs dam gtor ma chag med du gnang ba yin no/ /de nas rim pas chu lho brgyud ngor du phebs/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub ni zhing brjes nas mi bzhugs/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i drung du byon pa'i 'bul cha/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi phyi rten nang rten rnams la dkar me snyan dar/ tshogs pa la mang ja ga zi 'bom gsum la grwa ja sogs gnang cing /

de nas bzung nyer gcig mchod pa 'chag med du mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rim pas zla ba bzhi pa la gling khar phebs/ zla ba de ka'i nyer lnga la rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dus chen steng / rje btsun dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i gdan seng ge'i khri la/ snga so'i lung bstan dang mtshungs par dbang bskur zhing / rgyal tshab mchog tu mnga' gsol la/ de skabs byang nas mi sna gling pa kun dga' ba rnams 'byor ba'i rje'i drung du 'bul ba/ tshogs pa la mang ja gnang sbyin bkod yig rnams phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i 'bul cha gus pas 'bul bar mdzad cing / bla brang nas mang ja sogs snyed bkur nar mar gnang / de lo char che zhing skya rgyas pa sogs legs tshogs mchog tu che ba byung / rje nyid phebs dang bstun/ sngar mi yong ba'i bya khu byug cig dgon par byung nas/ skad snyan po sgrogs par gnang ba ni/ rje 'di dbus gtsang la snyan grags chen po byung ba dang / sa skya gong ma gtso bor bzhugs pa'i che dgu yongs kyi rnam 'dren dam par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /de nas bya lo gling kha thar pa rtser bzhugs nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la/ rje lha mchog seng ge'i dus chen steng dge 'dun nyer lnga la gsung ngag rin po che 'dzugs pa gnang / de nyin rang rgod ma rte'u ma gnyis 'bul mkhan byung ba ni/ rje nyid bsdu ba rnam bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ mkho dgu'i yo byad nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i rten cing 'brel byung nyid du gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de yang rje btsun sa paṇa gyis rgod ma mngal ldan nor 'phel te/ zhes 'byung ba dang mthun no/ /de nas dgung lo nga gsum du phebs pa chu pho byi lo/ dbus phyogs la spyan snga rin po che mjal bar phebs/ rje de nyid lugs gnyis dang 'brel bar bka' drin che ba nas/

bka' drin gyi cha bsab pa dang / rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba la gcig tu dgongs/ 'bul ba'i rnam grangs kyang stobs mi chung ba phul/ zla ba bzhi'i bar zab chos lhag ma rnams zhus shing / spyan snga rin po che'i sku la bcar ba'i phyag g.yog dang dgongs 'khrid tsam gyi sgo nas kyang thugs la 'jems par mdzad/ slar thabs mkhas kyis dgongs pa'i 'ching ba dkrol te/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid bka' yongs rdzogs/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ gsang 'dus skor gsum/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis rnams kyi dbang dang / nai gu chos drug gi khrid yongs rdzogs lung dang bcas pa/ grub chen brgyad bcu'i byin rlabs/ bka' gdams rin po che pha chos bu chos la sogs pa'i gsung chos mang du gnang la/ yang skabs skabs bde ldan phug tu phebs te/ dge 'dun rnams la mang ja la sogs pa zang zing gi gnang sbyin dang / rgyu lam gyi dbang / gur drag grub chen brgyad bcu'i byin rlabs sogs chos kyi sbyin pa dpag tu med pas/ kun kyang thar pa bla na med pa'i skal ba can du mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo nga lngar phebs pa'i shing pho byi lo'i skabs/ thub bstan yangs pa can du grwa tshang phan tshun gnyis 'then khyer gyi rnam par gzod ma zos ma bde'i slob gnyer gyi bar chad chen por 'gro ba zhig byung ba nas/ chos rgyal chen po kun dga' rin chen drung gi zhu bar/ thub bstan yangs pa can 'di grwa sa yag po rang gcig yod pa yin te/ mkhan slob 'then khyer gyis slob gnyer la gnod po rang zhig 'dug pas 'dir dkar khra'i phyogs lhung med pa kun mkhyen gyi grub mtha' yod nges gcig mi dgos kha med byung ba dang / dge 'dun rnams kyang mgrin gcig gi mthun grub yin pas/ 'di ka'i mkhan po cis kyang mdzad dgos nan phebs la brten/ zhal gyis bzhes te/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i bdag po mus rab 'byams pa byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang po'i khri thog tu phebs nas/

dbyar dgun gyi chos la phar tshad la sogs pa'i gzhung chos dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang / gur drag gi dbang / gzhan yang sngags chos don du gnyer ba la rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi sgo mang du gnang la/ de skabs 'phags pa sangs rgyas dar gyis dngul chur spyan drangs rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bka' drin bskyangs shing / gser sogs 'bul bas kyang mnyes par byas la/ rje rang gi phyag g.yog 'ga' yar la phur pa'i mtshams slob tu 'jug par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i phyi lo me stag la gling khar phebs nas bzhugs mtshams/ dbus nas spyan snga rin po che'i bka' shog nan chags phebs/ da lan chos gal che ba 'dra mi dgos kha med 'dug pas cis kyang 'byon dgos gsungs ba'i phebs sgo la brten/ me mo yos lo chibs kha shar du bsgyur nas/ spyan snga rin po che bya yul na bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs pas/ shin tu dges pa'i tshul gyis 'o da lan phebs pa shin tu legs byung / khyed da lo 'dir spyan drangs pa'i dgos pa deng sang sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung 'chad la khad 'dug pas spyan drangs pa yin pas gnang dgos gsungs/ der lum pa chos rje sogs stobs che ba la sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung tshang bar gnang zhing / bya yul dang lo bsgrags pa la dpon slob gnyis kas rgyun 'gyang tsam bzhugs te/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stobs che bar mdzad de thub pa bka' drin can gyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad par gnang ngo / /de nas sa skya bka' 'bum lung grol mtshams/ dpal na len+d+ra'i gdan sa mdzad dgos pa'i zhu ba mi sna dang bcas pa slebs byung ba la/ rje spyan snga rin po che yang thugs mnyes pa'i tshul gyis/ khyed na len+d+ra pa 'di/ khams pa sna mang gros kha ye med pa gcig 'dug pa la/ da lan gros legs 'di yang rong ston chen po'i thugs rjer 'dug gsungs pa dang / nged la yang da lan cis kyang 'byon dgos nan chags la brten/

tshes bcu gsum gza' skar stabs lor phebs/ de skabs zir bun gyi rnam pas 'jigs pa yang cung zad yod pa tshun/ lo nas snga bar chibs thog khel ba'i phu ri la rtser nam zi la phebs pa dang / na len dra phyogs nas bya rog gnyis rtse spyod la slebs pa'i ltong ltong gi sgra shin tu snyan pa dang bcas bsu ba'i tshul du zhag gnyis kyi sar slebs byung zhing / slar mda' rgyang gang tsam gyi sngon la phyin nas lam gyi nye logs su cung zad sgug pa'i rnam pa byed cing / sram pa shar zer ba'i yul gcig tu phebs mtshams khyim mi gcig pa gnyis su rje nyid spyan 'dren zhus 'dug pa/ rje nyid gar bzhugs kyi khang thog de kar babs nas/ spu dkrugs dang bcas bag phebs pa'i tshul gyi sdod pa dang / re 'ga' rab gsal dpyangs khar babs te/ rje nyid kyi sku la mgrin pa skyogs te blta ba dang / na len dra dang nye ba'i char phebs mtshams bya rog gnyis ltong ltong sgrogs shing / gshog bsgyur dang bcas gzhungs te dgon par 'phur song ba'i de ma thag na len dra'i dge 'dun rnams gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i bla gos dang bcas phan tshun tshar du dngar ba'i zab bshom gyis/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / phye phur dang rol mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa dang bcas phebs bsur slebs shing / de'i tshe sngar gtan med pa'i lung pa zhig nas chu'i rgyun gsar du brdol te/ rje nyid phebs pa'i sku'i mdun sar 'khyil ba'i tshul gyis byung ba la/ der gnas rnams ya mtshan dang ngo mtshar du 'dzin zhing dga' dga' ltar byed la/ rje nyid kyi dgongs par yang / rten 'brel bzang / dgon pa 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan thogs cung zad yong ba srid dgongs pa'i thugs 'dun yang shar gsungs/ de ltar zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dpal na len dra'i chos grwa chen por phebs/ de nas nyer gcig la rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor 'dzoms pa la/

ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi skye ba dgu pa/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rong ston shes bya kun rig gi mtshan dngos shākya rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la 'dren pa dam pa 'di lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par mnga' gsol rab tu gnas pa'i me tog rgyas par phul ba yin no zhes thos so/ /gnas der dge 'dun drug brgya skor la/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid rgyas pa so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa/ rags bsdus la dbang gong ma/ gsang 'dus skor gsum/ dmar po skor gsum/ rdo rje phur pa/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa rnams kyi dbang dang / dzam dmar gnyis sogs rjes gnang bzhi cu tsam/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang / rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa/ skya ser stong phrag drug tsam la chos kyi rgyal po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nas brgyud pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo sogs gnang zhing / de skabs kyang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya lhag pa/ skya ser stong tsam la gu ru drag po'i dbang sogs/ kun kyang thar pa bla na med pa'i skal ba can du mdzad de/ slar spyan snga rin po che'i drung du phebs ngos bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don du rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i gdan bzhugs phul spyan snga rin po ches kyang re zhig bzhugs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ de skabs kyang dad pa stobs su gyur pas 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya mi chung ba phul cing / sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gnang grub pa'i skabs shig tshes bco lnga'i mtshan gcig mnal lam du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la phur ba zhig ches myur ba'i tshul gyis grib so dang bcas nub par nye ba'i tshe/ rje nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas nyi ma sdod gnon gyi stangs ka mdzad pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la phur tshugs su gtad pas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'khyil ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin thub cing /

'od zer shin tu che zhing mdzes pa dang bcas pa'i thugs nyams shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ba la/ nyams sad 'phral thugs la the tshom cung zad dang bcas/ phyag g.yog rnams la de ka'i bka' stsal phebs shing / de nas tshes bcu dgu'i nyin grib rkyen shin tu che ba zhig gi nyer len la brten/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung sku shin tu dub pa'i tshul bstan pa la/ de'i nyin 'jun pa chos rje dang / lum pa chos rje sogs la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sta gon gcig myur bar gnang ste sku mdun phebs pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas mnyes pa'i tshul gyis zhal 'dzum dang bcas/ do nub 'byon mi dgos/ skyon gang yang med gsung ba phebs nas/ de nub bzhugs/ sang snga bar thugs dam rgyun bzhes grol mtshams/ rje nyid dge slong dkon mchog bzang po/ dge slong dpal ldan/ gzhi ba'i dge slong gcig gcig rnams kyis phyag phyi byas/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi cho ga rgyas pa gzungs ring brgya lnga bcu nga gcig sogs bzlas pa'i khrus bum bsnams te/ sku drung byon pas sku dub nyams chen po 'dug pa la/ phyag g.yog pas rje nyid phebs tshul zhus pas/ dges pa'i ngang nas/ skyon gang yang med/ rlung ltas rmi ltas ma log pas/ ci yang mi skyon gsungs pa la/ rje 'dis/ 'o na 'di lta bu'i nyog tshul ston pa ci yin/ bdag cag ltos bcas rnams la dgongs shing / sku khrus 'di 'bul ba yin gsungs pas/ de bzhin mdzod gsungs/ sku khrus bzhes nas dpon slob lhan cig dum tsam bzhugs pas/ sku shin tu dwangs pa'i ngos nas/ nged kyis dang po slob gnyer dang chos 'tshol lugs 'di bzhin byas gsungs pa sogs rgyas par gnang zhing dges dges mdzad la/ de nas nyi ma gnyis kyi bar sku khrus phul bas/ sku khams shin du dwangs ba'i skabs nas/ da gdan bzhugs gcig kyang phul gsungs pa ltar phul ngos/ da rung lo lnga zhabs brtan dgos zhus pas/ de ka byed khyed kyang na len dra'i gdan sa lo lnga mdzad dgos gsungs pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes par mdzad ngos/

dgongs pa 'ching ba lan gcig dkrol/ byin rlabs zhus/ smon lam btab/ myur du mjal ba'i dgongs pa zhus te/ chibs kyi kha lo gtsang phyogs la bsgyur/ thog mar thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge bshes lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag du ma tshar du dngar bas bsu ba dang / ser 'phrang rgyas par mdzad/ de'i tshe bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char phabs pa la brten/ rje 'di nyid kyis gsung gis dge 'dun rnams nged rang la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yod pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs shing / de nas tshogs pa la mang ja/ mkhan slob rnams la gnang sbyin bzang zhing gya nom pa mdzad de/ thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs/ der yang dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis/ rol mo'i bye brag dar chen gdugs/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pas/ phebs bsu rgya cher mdzad de/ der yang tshogs su mang ja/ dge 'dun bcu phrag re la/ dar kha re re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang zhing / dbyar chos la der bzhugs nas/ phar phyin dang tshad ma sogs gzhung che phra rnams 'chad nyan dang bsdus grwa yan gnang nas/ pho brang chen po ngam ring la 'khor tsam phebs/ sde bdag zhal ngo rnams dang mjal 'phrad legs par mdzad rjes/ tshur lam blom po chab tshan na rje btsun rin po che bsod nams rtse mo bzhugs 'dug pa la/ khang gsar lcags kha nas snga 'gros brdzangs te/ byin rlabs zhu bar yong na e khyab snyan du phul bas/ nga'i rtsar khyed mi 'byon na su 'byon/ cis kyang phebs pa legs gsungs nas sku mdun du phebs/ gsol ja 'debs kha yar gyi bar la dgon pa'i 'dzin bkod mdzad dka'i rnam grangs sogs zhib rgyas su phul bas thugs yid shin tu ches pa'i tshul gyis dges dges dang / slar yang 'dzin skyong gi cha 'di dang 'di lta bu gnang dgos zhes zhib rgyas gnang ba'i mthar/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba gcig brgyud mar grags pa'i zab chos chos 'brel du zhus shing /

phyag zhabs dbu gtsug tu bzhag pa'i brgyud pa'i byin rlabs shin tu rgyas pa/ chos skyongs bka' sgo dang bcas pa mdzad rjes/ rgyal pos 'bangs la bsgo ba'i tshul du/ da nga rgas pas mi dgos/ khyed dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos srung du gtogs pa thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa chen po 'di'i rjes su rgyugs la ji ltar bsgo ba'i 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs shig ces cung zad thugs nyams 'ur ba'i rnam pas/ gsungs dpangs mthon po gnang ba la/ rje 'di nyid kyang sku lus kyi ba spu g.yos shing zil nyams che ba dang bcas chibs thog khel ba yang ma dran pa'i nyams 'ur lta bu'i a mthas kyi 'dzin pa gang yang med par hed pa'i ngang nas/ phyag phyi ba rnams kyis kyang chibs rjes ma zin par lho gong khar phebs pa yin no/ /zhes pa dpon slob zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams snyon med du grags pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas tshur res gsang sngags rdo rje gling du phebs/ mang ja dge 'dun bcu re la dar kha re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad ngos/ bde ldan phug tu phebs shing / der yang mang ja dar 'gyed gnang rjes/ gling dga' bde ba can du phebs/ mang ja dar 'gyed sogs/ chos dang zang zing gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad cing / skal ba dang ldan pa dag thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon gyi sgos skal can du bsgrubs pa yin no/ /de nas me mo sbrul lo ngor nas rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i drung gling dga'i rten mjal dang chab tshan la phebs byung ba/ der bzhugs ring dpon slob rnams la phyag phyi dang / 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad rjes/ rje 'di nyid kyis kyang tshogs pa la mang ja dang / thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad sogs gsung chos 'ga' yar gnang ngos/ dpon slob gnyis ka phyogs mthun gle lung chos sder phebs pa'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stobs che ba mdzad ngos/ rje nyid gling gar phebs/

phyogs nas 'dus pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun rnams la gsung ngag rin po che shin tu rgyas pa yig cha so so'i lung dang bcas pa gnang la/ de skabs dge 'dun blo gsal ba 'gas rje'i gsung la zin thun 'debs pa'ang mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum lam 'bras kyi cha lag 'ga'/ do pa legs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i gcod khrid chen mo'i lung sogs/ dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po phab ste/ der tshogs thams cad thugs lhag par tshim zhing ngo mtshar gyi gnas la re par mdzad pa yin no/ /lo de'i zla ba bcu pa la dbus na len+d+rar phebs pa'i phebs lam rtse gdong mdog spyod du/ dpal sa skya pa bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rgyu lam lam zab rnal 'byor ma/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / tshe dpag med dze ta ri dang / grub rgyal ma'i dbang gnang / des kyang shin tu gus pa'i tshul gyis 'bul nod bsnyen bkur bzang po mdzad cing / rim pas na len+d+rar phebs/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba dang ser 'phreng rgya chen po mdzad/ de skabs mdo khams shar nas/ a li chos rje dpon slob drug brgya skor phebs pa'i longs spyod stobs che ba nas mang ja su 'dren la mi 'chams pa byung la/ rje nyid khri thog spyan 'dren zhus nas/ nyin gcig rang la/ ja gos dar dres sogs kyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba rgya tshan drug dang / gzhan yang 'bul ba'i rnam grangs shin tu mang bas dad ldan dag bsod nams gyis gnas la yid 'dun par mdzad pa yin la/ der dge 'dun stong tsam la gsung ngag lam 'bras shin tu rgyas pa gnang / rgyu dus kyi dbang la skya ser stobs ches pas zla gcig zhag gcig 'gor zhing thugs bskyed chen mo snga rting la mi drug stong tsam 'tshogs shing / de nas gsung ngag grol mtshams tshogs pa la gsang 'dus skor gsum gyi dbang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs sogs dang /

de nas rags bsdus la lam 'bras kyi cha lag rnams gnang ste/ phebs lam bkras la brgyud/ po tor phebs/ po to ba chen po'i sku dang chos skyong la snyan dar dkar me phul/ bstan pa rin po che dar zhing skye dgu bde ba'i phyir du smon lam mdzad de/ de nas phra phur phebs/ zhang rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi sku la snyan dar dang dkar me phul/ der yang gong bzhin smon lam mdzad/ de nas spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i drung du skabs kyang bka' drin cha bsab pa dang / tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ 'bul ba'i rnam grangs nyer lnga tsam phul cing bzhugs pa'i skabs shig spyan snga rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar rje 'di nyid kyis spyan phye ste/ de nub bla ma la cher gtad kyi gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i mnal lam du/ rje dkon mchog rin po che/ rje bkra shis brtan pa/ rje nam mkha' dbang phyug rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas bzhi po nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba'i nyams gsal po byung gsungs cing / de skabs spyan la yang bde skyed yod pa byung bas/ spyan snga rin po che thugs shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas/ 'o legs byung da sems bde gsungs pa dang / dpon slob byin yang thugs dges pa'i tshul gyis yar phyogs 'byon par bzhed pa'i/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung du rim pas dgongs grol zhus pa la/ cung zad thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pas/ na len+d+ra'i gdan sa yang lo re lo gnyis mdzad dgos shing / nged la yang tshe dbang kha yar dang / rgyu lam gyi dbang zhig gnang bskyang dgos gsungs pa la/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas khyed lta bu la bdag gi dbang 'bul ga la spobs/ bdag la slar rgyu lam gyi dbang zhig bka' drin kyang dgos shing / na len+d+ra'i thad la dgongs grol cis kyang dgos zhes nan zhus dang / rje nyid bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du rgyun ring bzhugs dgos tshul phul bas/ khyed na len dra'i gdan sa mdzad na nged kyis kyang lo re lo gnyis sdod gsungs pa phebs 'dug kyang rje nyid na len dra'i zhal bdag mi spro ba'i stabs gsal kha gang yang ma zhus par bzhugs pa la brten/

phyag g.yog 'ga' zhig la ci zer sngar rje nyid nged kyi gang zhus kyang dang len mdzad pa zhig yod pa la/ da lan gang zhus kyang mi gsan pa 'dug gsungs pa phebs 'dug cing / slar yang rim pas nan gyis zhu grol phul ba la brten/ dgongs pa lhod grol ngos/ rgyu lam gyi dbang bka' drin du stsal cing / yong khar byin rlabs zhus bstan 'gro'i don du yun ring du bzhugs pa'i smon lam btab mtshams phyag tshur thongs gsungs/ nged kyi mthe bong gnyis kyis bsdus te/ phebs lam rnams la thugs rtog zhib bzhes dang / bstan pa spyi dgos kyi rgyun la dgongs pa'i thugs kyi khur che dgos shing / da sa thag gi bskal bas yang yang mjal thub pa dka'/ 'on kyang nged rang skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du nam yang mi 'bral gsungs phyag la bcangs bcangs lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad rjes/ thugs rje bla lhag tu g.yos pa'i stabs kyis spyan chab mdzad byung bas/ der sku mdun na yod pa tshang ma mchi ma lhug par gtong gin 'dug kyang / nged de dus gang byung rung / mchi ma yang ma shor byung / de dus snying sran yang chen po ka byas 'dug cing / na len dra'i bdag lo re lo gnyis byed tshul zhus na/ sku tshe la khyad yong shas 'dug ste ma byung 'dug gsungs thugs 'gyod bcas kyi rnam pa mdzad cing / nga'i bla ma de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gcig yod do gsungs/ thugs cung zad 'byung ba'i rnam pa mdzad pa thos la/ de nas byin rlabs zhus skye ba dang tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med kyi smon lam btab/ sems 'phreng bzhin pa'i ngang nas yar phyogs phebs pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas na len+d+rar 'khor tsam phebs/ chos rje grags 'byor shes rab pa'i dbon po/ lum pa chos rje zur mchad la bkod pa gnang / lcags pho rta lo zla ba bcu pa la thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs/ mang ja brgyad rgyas tsam gnang / chos rje gdan sa pa dkon mchog dpal ldan pa la lam 'bras cha lag yongs rdzogs gnang dgos tshul byung ba nas/

bla ma dam pa'i dam tshig la dgongs/ gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la ldong mkhar chos rdzong du phebs/ ngor nas rje dkon mchog dpal ldan pa dang / chos rje blo gros rgyal po/ kun mkhyen dbon po dang bcas pa rnams la lam 'bras cha lag yongs rdzogs dang / rjes gnang gi rigs mang po gnang nas/ slar thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs ngos/ chos rje blo gros rgyal po ba/ yangs pa can gyi gdan sa khri thog tu bkod pa gnang ste/ rje nyid gling dga' bde ba can du phebs/ de nas dgung lo drug cu re gnyis su phebs pa lcags mo lug la lam zab bla ma brgyud pa'i sku brnyan mda' gang tsam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga sman skur ba sgrubs shing bzhugs gnas kyi gtsug lag khang yang bzhengs/ nang bzhugs la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar dang / gzhan yang mkhas grub du ma'i gdung ring bsrel/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan sngags/ gzungs chen lnga la sogs pa'i gzungs sngags khyad par can mang po bzhugs par mdzad/ rten rnams kyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gza' skar bzang po la/ rje 'di nyid kyis gtso mdzad/ bde kye'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu dang bcas pas/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten/ sta gon dngos gzhi nyi ma gsum mdzad nas/ rab tu gnas pa lhag gnas kyi me tog 'bul bar mdzad cing / ye shes pa bstim pa'i tshe/ sngags sum brgya re mdzad nas/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar zhing / mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas lha khang steng na bzhugs so/ /de'i skabs/ dge slong brtson 'grus dpal gyis bzhengs pa'i rje nyid kyi sku 'dra che ba la yang / rab gnas mnyam du med de/ lha khang bar rdo rje 'chang gi drung na bzhugs shing / de lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi mthu phun sum tshogs pa la brten/ char chu dus su 'bab cing lo legs pa la sogs pa dge ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung ngo /
