/lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin rigs ldan mi'i dbang po kun dga' rin chen drung gis rje nyid spyan 'dren gyi pho nya zhu yig nan chags dang bcas pa phebs pa nas/ tshes brgyad la gling kha nas chibs thog tu khel te/ tshes bco lnga la rma bya shug khrod du phebs ngos/ tshes bcu bdun gza' skar bzang ba dang bstun/ thog mar bkra shis pa'i mtshon don du/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang mdzad rjes/ zla ba de'i ring la tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / grub rgyal ma brgya bcu gcig re re/ gzhan yang 'byung 'dul me dbang / rdo rje rnam 'joms/ rme brtsegs ljang dud/ gur zhal gyi rjes gnang / bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang la sogs pa dgongs bzhed ltar phul nas/ slar mchod yon phyogs mthun ngam ring su phebs shing / zhal ngo gzhan so sor yang dgongs bstun gyi gsung chos/ dbang rjes gnang mang du gnang la/ khyad par mi dbang bkra shis stobs rgyas drung dang / gcung lha'i sras po yid bzhin nor bu'i drung phyogs mthun bzhugs skabs/ dus 'khor rtser spyan drangs pa'i gur drag gi dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ tshe dbang / rme brtsegs/ gur lha brgyad/ dur khrod bdag po/ dud gsol lha mo sogs gsung chos du ma gnang zhes slar gling dga' bde ba can du phebs/ der yang / gsung chos blo dang mtshams pa bka' drin stsol zhing bzhugs skabs thub bstan rnam rgyal nas mi sna yang yang slebs pa'i gsung ngag lam 'bras gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan zhus rim can du byung ba la brten/ chu pho sprel lo zla ba gsum pa shar dus phebs/ thub bstan yangs pa can du zhag gcig bzhugs/ dge 'dun rnams la mang ja bzang po gnang / de nas thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis phreng du dngar ba'i phebs bsu zab pa mdzad cing / rje nyid kyis mang ja bzang po yang gnang / zla ba de'i nyer dgu la paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa'i zla mchod steng du/

kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po go rams bstan pa'i gsal byed nyid kyi mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri la rje btsun 'di nyid bzhugs te/ chos rje rin po che byams pa rab brtan pas gtso mdzad dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag tsam la/ gsung ngag lam 'bras cha lag mang du gnang zhing / slar yar phyogs la phebs nas gling khar bzhugs skabs sprel bya'i mtshams mi dbang chen pos rma bya shug khrod du spyan drangs/ zla ba gnyis kyi bar dbang byin rlabs mang du gnang zhing / rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog gi skyesarabs bcu gcig sku brnyan rnams la/ lta gon dngos gzhi sbrel ba'i rab gnas mdzad pas/ me tog gi char shug khrod dang ngam ring gnyis char du cher babs shing / slar gling khar phebs te bzhugs pa la/ chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen drung gis gsung ngag lam 'bras gnang dgos kyi zhu nan phul bas bdag khams bzang po mi gda' na'ang / thugs bzhed yod na 'bul gsungs/ khyi lo zla ba gsum pa la chibs thog khel ba'i yar lam sman sdings su lo chen sprul pa'i sku la rgyu dus kyi dbang / mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / tshe bka' rnams gnang rjes shug khrod du phebs/ de nas chos kyi rgyal po lo chen sprul sku/ grub chen thang stong pa'i dbon brgyud rje 'gyur med sogs brgyad bcur nye ba la/ lam 'bras khrid/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ glegs bam tshang ma/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ rdo rje gur rnams kyi lung gnang zhing / rags bsdus bcu gcig la/ lam sbas bshad ma gtogs cha lag tshang ma bka' drin du stsal to/ /de skabs sa skya nas/ bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen drung gis bka' shog nan che ba'i gdung brgyud rin po che sku mched sogs la gsung ngag dgos tshul mi sna dang bcas pa la brten/ rje 'di'i zhal nas/ da ni gser ga bdag po'i dper 'dug pas/ cis kyang 'bul ba spro gsungs pa dang / sde pa nas kyang phebs pa rigs tshul nan chags phul ba la brten/

zhal gyis bzhes te ngam ring du phebs skabs/ spyan 'dren skyar ma byung nas/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum la/ sde srid nam mkha'i rgyal po dpon g.yog rnams kyis phyag phyi mdzad de/ mchod yon rnams lha rtser phebs zhag gsum bzhugs/ slar tshes bdun la chibs thog khel ba'i dkar gong la bar sde srid nas kyang phebs skyel mdzad/ de nas gdong dga' nas dpon g.yog lnga bcu tsam phebs bsur slebs pa'i de nub gdong dgar bzhugs/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gdong dga' nas dpon g.yog rnams kyis phyag g.yog byas/ dpal ldan sa skya yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas gang du phebs shing / mkhan chen/ las chen sogs stobs che bas phebs bsu ser 'phrang rgyas par mdzad/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po 'phags pa rin po che'i gzim khang lha khang chen mo ru spyan drangs/ 'khon sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras dang mjal/ thugs mnyes pa'i tshul gyis bka' ji snyed pa dag phebs la/ rje 'dis kyang tshogs chen la mang ja bzang po/ grwa tshang tha dad kyi mkhan po las chen sogs la rnam gzhag thob pa rnams la gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad de/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi lha mchod steng du gdung sras rin po che sku mched/ mkhan chen rnam gnyis/ las chen gnyis/ gdong dga' chos rje sogs/ dge 'dun phyed dang nyis brgya tsam la gsung ngag 'dzugs pa gnang / de'i dgong rje 'di nyid kyi mnal lam du/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen phebs nas mnyes pa'i tshul mang po mdzad pa zhig byung bas/ sang snga bar sku drung na yod pa rnams la nged rang gi lam 'bras 'di la gegs dbang bar chad mi yong gsung ba'i bka' lung yang phebs ngos/ sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi dmigs khrid/ dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi dmigs khrid rnams rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mdzes rgyan las tshig zur yang ma nyams pa'i khrid lugs dang /

de dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed/ rgyu lam gyi dbang / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa/ bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba nas bzung / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs sa lo'i rnam thar bar tshang ma/ glegs bam chos sna lnga bcu nga bzhi/ dbang chu dang sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi drug gnyis kyi lung la sogs pa rgyas par gnang zhing / bdag chen rin po che sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i rags bsdus bco lnga la/ lam 'bras kyi cha lag rnams kyang yongs su rdzogs par bka' drin du stsal cing / dmigs rim re re'i sngon du rjes gnang re gnang ba yang / thog mar tshe 'phel dkar po'i rjes gnang nas bzung / 'phags pa thogs med kyis zhal gzigs byams pa dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs lha sum cu so drug gi rjes gnang so so yig lung dang bcas pa gnang zhing / gdung sras sku mched kyis gtsos/ dpon slob rnams dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod chen por mnga' gsol ba'i bka' drin chos yon du/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi 'bul ba'i rnam grangs ji snyed pas kyang phan tshun legs lam gyi rten 'brel mchog tu mdzad la/ de dus kyang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bzhi bcu tsam mdzad/ de'i skabs gcig dbu rtse rnying ma dang sgo rum sogs kyi rten rnams mjal ba la phebs/ dkar me snyan dar phul/ bstan pa dar zhing skye dgu bde ba'i smon lam thugs yid tshims par mdzad pas/ mahā ka la'i 'chams sku'i spyan dbus ma de shin tu gsal ba gcig gzigs byung ba'i gnas tshul bdag chen rin po cher zhus pas/ dges pa'i gsung gis spyan dbus ma gzigs pa de ye shes kyi spyan gzigs par gdon mi za ba yin gsungs la/ de skabs dpal ldan sa skya pa sngags 'chang chen po'i drung du/ phur pa sa lugs smin byed kyi dbang / stod las smad las kyi dbang tshang ma/ de dag gi rgyab chos sa los mdzad pa/

phur pa'i dbang / lam gyi rim pa bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub kyi rol mtsho zhes pa dpal ldan bla ma/ theg chen chos rgyal nas sa lo'i bar zhal ngo rim par brgyud pa dang / yang bla ma dam pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po sogs la brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi drag po sgrol dbang / chos rje bla ma nas/ chag lo'i bar gyi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/ sa los mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed/ dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bklags pa don 'grub/ sngags 'chang chen po de nyid rang gis mdzad pas dkyil chog blo gros kha 'byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' bskyed/ drag po sgrol dbang gis mtshams sbyor/ yang sa los mdzad pa'i gsal byed rin po che'i do shal/ phur pa'i gtor bzlog bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ yang gur drag gi 'phrin las drag po zil gnon/ de'i dbang bskur sngags 'chang chen po rang gis mdzad pa rnams legs par gsan cing mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas/ 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pa yang bgyis pa yin no/ /de nas gdung sras rin po che sku mched kyis gtsos/ dpon slob mang pos thag ring tsam bskyel dung mdzad/ phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam gyi spro ba bskyed ngos/ rim pas rma bya shug khrod dge legs yongs 'du'i tshal du phebs te/ 'du khang gi ldebs bris rnams la rab gnas rgyas pa dang / sde srid zhal ngo so sor dgongs sbyar gyis bka' chos gnang ba mdzad rjes/ slar yang gling khar phebs/ dge 'dun rnams la sku 'khyos tshul du mang ja gnang sbyin sogs mdzad/ dgun chos thog de kar bzhugs/ dpon slob bdun bcu skor gyis gur gyi sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshogs dbu la rje nyid phebs ngos/ bsnyen bkur rnams kyang bla brang nas 'khur bzhes su mdzad la de'i skabs gling gar mgon khang du bzhugs rgyu'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi sku brnyan zhig bzhengs pa la/

spyan 'byed ran mtshams rten 'brel legs lam gyi spyan 'byed ston mo che chung gang 'os re rgyun gyi phyag srol yin yang / bla brang nas rgyun phogs bzang zhing zur chas yang yang gnang ba sogs kyi/ sems 'dzangs kyi rnam pas zhu ma spobs par/ spyan 'byed 'dzugs grabs yod pa/ rje nyid thob rgyag tu mkho dgu'i gnang sbyin dang bcas phebs byung ba ni mngon par mkhyen pa kho na las gzhan du ma 'das la/ de nas rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs te/ dpal dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i lha gnas kyi me tog nyin mo'i snga cha la 'thor bar mdzad pas/ mgon khang rgya dkar la nyi zer thal shar ba dang / phyir gnas kyi skya ser kun gyis mthong snang chabs gcig par/ mgon khang gi rgya skar la kha dog sna tshogs pa can gyi 'ja' zug par snang la/ gtor 'bul skabs/ mgon khang gi rten thug rnams la/ me cher 'bar ba sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can mang du byung ba dang / byin rlabs kyi zil yang shin tu che ba byung bas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos srung 'di rnams rje nyid kyi phrin las sar gor ma chag ces rig byed mkhas pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i ngag las dngos slob 'gas thos pa bzhin/ phyis dpon slob drung du zhus dag zhus pas kyang / de kho na ltar yid ches pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin no zhes thos so/ /de skabs chos rje blo gros rgyal po gshegs pa la brten/ slar yang thub bstan zhal bdag mdzad dgos zhu nan stabs/ dgung lo re drug bzhes pa shing mo phag lo slar yang thub bstan du phebs/ dge 'dun rnams la mang ja gnang sbyin phul du phyin pa mdzad pa'i skabs shig thub bstan rnam rgyal gdan sa pa/ rje byams pa rab brtan pa dang / dpon slob rnam gnyis kyis gtsos dge 'dun sum cu tsam phebs shing gzhan yang lo chen sprul sku/ grwa tshang chen mo'i mkhan chen dkon mchog bzang po/

yangs pa can gyi slob dpon rnam gnyis sogs/ dad 'dus kyi dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung bcas pa dang / gzhan yang lung mang po gnang zhing / drag pa bdun bcu skor la/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / de gsum ga'i rdzogs rim gyi khrid/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang bcas pa/ dpyid thig rgyu lam gyi dbang / bdag med ma'i dbang / lam zab rnams dang / gzhan yang nag po gzhung drug rim bzhi lam slong / bde mchog rtsa rgyud sogs zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor dpag med bskor nas/ slar zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin/ rma bya shug khrod du phebs/ sde srid zhal ngo rnams la gang la gang mtshams kyi chos kyi bka' drin stsal nas/ yang mus la phebs/ mtha' khong brgyud gling gar phebs ngos re zhig sku mtshams bcad rgya dam par bzhugs/ grol 'phral dge 'dun rnams la bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / de dag so so'i khrid lung dang bcas pa stsal la/ de nas dgung lo re bdun du phebs pa me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba gsum pa'i nang du/ phyogs nas 'dus pa mang po la/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bka' drin du bstsal nas/ zla ba bzhi pa rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i dus chen steng gur gyi sgrub mchod tshogs dbu la rje nyid phebs shing bsnyen bkur dgos pa/ bla brang rang nas rkang blang khur bzhes mdzad do/ /de nas yang thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs skabs chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen pa'i drung yang phebs pa mdzad la/ de skabs kyang / dbang bka' bsam las 'das pa bka' drin bskyangs shing / chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed pa bskor nas/ yang zla ba bcu gcig pa la mus su phebs/ nang so rin chen lhun po bas/ gle lung chos sder spyan 'dren zhus/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis ser phreng rgyas par mdzad/ de'i nyin dge 'dun rnams la mang ja bzang po dang /

zhal ngo rnams la 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang bskur gnang zhing / sang nyin mkhan chen chos dbang phyug pas gtso mdzad skya ser mang po la don zhags lha lnga'i rjes gnang mdzad nas gling khar phebs/ de'i phyi lo me mo glang la/ gling khar gsung ngag lam 'bras 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i snang gsum skabs/ ngam ring nas chos rgyal chen po kun dga' rin chen sku khams bsnyel ba la brten/ spyan 'dren yang yang byung ba'i stabs/ snang gsum gyi dmigs rim tshang bar song mtshams/ shar stabs kyis phebs pa gnang ba la/ chos rgyal chen po sku khams re zi 'dug pa nas/ thog mar tshe dpag med kyi dbang dang mgon po'i rjes gnang mdzad cing / de nas dbyibs sgo la brten/ kun rig gi dbang dang / dgong re bzhin bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs bar ma chad pa gnang yang / 'bangs rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu zhan pa la brten/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul ston par brtsams pa'i tshe/ thugs brtse ba chen pos byin rlabs dang / 'da' ka ma'i 'pho dmigs bka' drin du bskyangs shing / de nas rjes sgrub kyi cha gdung zhugs 'bul/ gdung tsha 'debs pa/ dgung zhag gi ring la gsol 'debs sogs/ gang la gang dgos rnams brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas/ bka' drin du mdzad cing / dngos gzhi la/ dpal ngam ring chos sde chen por sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su seng ge'i khri la rje nyid spyan drangs te/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas/ lhag chad nor gsum gyi skyon dang bral zhing / dag gsal snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i gsung gis dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa dang 'brel ba'i rgyas bshad phyin chad phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal yon dam pa 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi mtha' rten rgyas pa mdzad la/ der skabs zhing yongs su dag pa'i bla ma/

sde pa nas kyang yon yongs su dag pa'i dngos po bzang zhing dpag tu med pa 'bul bar mdzad pa sogs/ rang gzhan mtha' dag rnam par dkar ba'i legs lam gyi bsags rgyab rmad du byung ba la yang dag par sbyor ba mdzad pa yin no/ /dbyar gsos gling khar phebs/ sngar gyi gsung ngag gi 'phro rdzogs par gnang zhing / yang skabs gcig dbyar smad/ dol pa smad pas spyan drangs te ru khrod du phebs/ kham dol sgos ru sbrang g.yag 'dab ru/ sgom sde sogs stobs che ba la tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs gnang zhing / 'brog rigs 'di'ang / phan tshan 'dres 'khrugs che ba rang gi cha shar tshe/ mi sha nor she stes lan sogs la/ gnad po rang gi sdig g.yos chen por 'gyur ba yong gi 'dug pa/ thugs rje'i rgya mtsho chen pos ma bzod pas/ phan tshun so sor gang la gang 'tshams kyi gsol ras gnang sbyin 'di phyir phan gnod kyi khye nyen bkod tshul sogs rgyas par gnang rjes/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho dpang por spyan drangs pa'i gtor dbang bka' bsgo rgyas par mdzad/ sde gcig gis gcig la rgyag khyer dang / rku 'phrog byed sa med pa'i sgrigs rnam gzhag dam po mdzad rjes/ phyag gis gtor ma sa la 'phangs pas gtor ma'i gsum gnyis tsam sa la thim pa der yod kyi skya ser kun gyi mig lam du mthong ba la brten/ thams cad kyang ha las shing 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rje nyid kyi bka' las nam yang 'da' bar mi nus pa'i yid ches thob cing / mos pa lhag par 'phel ba'i dbang las/ phyag zhabs kyi byin rlabs 'phung tshul gyi zhu ba dang / 'bul ba'i dngos po yang / mar khal lnga brgya lhag tsam/ 'bri g.yag nyis brgya skor/ rnga ma dkar nag sogs ji snyed pa dag gis kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par sgrub pa'i skal ba can du mdzad pa yin no/ /slar thub bstan du phebs 'bri g.yag rnams kyi steng nas thub bstan du dge rgyun stobs che ba sbyor bar mdzad de/

gling gar phebs te/ der yang mang ja la sogs pa'i gnang sbyin mang po mdzad de/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam sku mtshams bsdams bzhugs skabs/ sku dog cung zad la brten pa'i mnal du ye mi 'gro bar snyan la 'ur sgra chen po 'byung zhing / re 'ga' kha dog sna tshogs pa'i zir zir char 'bab pa lta bu'i nyams dang / re 'ga' 'di yin rigs mtshon med pa'i mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul lta bu gzugs che chung grangs med pa sa gzhi ri klung gzim khang gi nang tshang ma gang ba la sogs pa'i thugs nyams sna tshogs nyin mtshan 'da' ba 'byung yang / de dag la bden 'dzin a mthas med par thams cad kyang / sems snang tsam las phyi rol na grub pa rdul tsam yang med par thugs thag rbad chod pa'i bde nyams de ka las sdug bsngal gyi snang cha gtan nas med kyang / drung na gnas pa rnams bla mar yid 'dun pa'i sems kyis blos pa mi bzod cing / 'tshab pa'i tshul gyis/ gling khar/ ber thul sogs na bza'i rigs mang po dang / mchod cha sogs skam spyad mang ba/ mang ja brgya lhag dge 'dun rnams la nas khal 'gyed/ g.yag bzhi bcu/ lug nyis brgya skor gnang nas/ sku rim la brtson pa dang bde ldan phug tu yang / mang ja sum cu lhag tsam/ nas 'gyed lnga dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rdo rje gling / gle lung chos sde mtha' khongs sogs su gong ltar stobs che ba'i sku rim dang / rta mo lung pa la nas 'gyed lan gsum/ thub bstan go gnyis su yang / mang ja nyis sbrel gsum sbrel nas 'gyed lan gsum/ mdo phyogs nyer mkho'i po ti'i mi khur gnyis sogs rten ji snyed pa dang bcas sku rim 'jur bar bsgrubs pa'i mthu dang / ched du dpal ldan sa skyar chibs pa bzang shos phul ba'i sku rim rting bskul zhus/ sa skya tshogs su mang ja/ sgo rum/ kha'u skyed lhas/ byas 'gyur/ bzhi thog nang so sogs/ mgon khang so sor bskang gso gtor sgrub rgyas par gnang zhing / zhu yig rten bcas dang /

dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /yi dam bka' srung mthu rtsal can rnams kyis/ /rgya mtsho lta bur bstan pa spel byed pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma lo brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa phebs shing / 'di tshogs su tshugs la/ gsol ba thob/ sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs pa nas/ de bzhin mdzad/ de'i dus rje 'di nyid kyi mnal lam du/ gling skya nas dgon pa la tshur phebs/ dbu gsum yod pa'i ka nang gcig na/ chos dung dkar po gcig 'dug pas/ 'di dgon pa'i chos dung du 'dug snyam bsnams te/ gyu mo na tshur phebs pa dang / g.yag shor phyogs nas/ rta pa mang po gcig gis ded byung ba la bros byon pas/ bya mchu ma phyogs nas kyang / rta pa de bzhin byung bas/ de ma thag dgon pa'i steng gi nam mkha' 'thon por 'phur byon pas/ nga la 'di bzhin yong ba rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi sku drin yin dgongs pa thugs la shar ba dang mnyam du 'od gsal sad byung gsungs la/ mdor na dam pa 'di nyid rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dang skad cig kyang 'bral ba med pa nyid du gdon mi za bas legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel mtha' dag 'di kho na las 'grig par mngon no/ /yang thugs nyams sna tshogs pa de dag gi skabs shig rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa gzi brjid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa zhig gzigs snang dang de nyid rje rang la thim ngos/ de'i nga rgyal gyis sdigs mdzub gtad cing bzhugs pas/ sngar gyi mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul lta bu'i zar zir de dag phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' la bskrad cing med par byas pa'i thugs nyams shin tu dwangs ba zhig byung zhing / de phyin gzugs sna tshogs pa can gyi zar zir de nam mkha'i sprin dwangs pa bzhin ye ma byung zhing / de nas sku khams kyang je dwangs la song ba yin la/ kha dog sna tshogs pa can gyi me tog 'dab ma bzhi pa dang /

lnga pa sogs mdzes shing rnam grangs mang ba yong gin 'dug pa la/ sngar bzhin rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lta stangs dang bcas 'bud grabs mdzad pas/ nged rnams khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba yin pas ma 'bud zer zhing / 'ja'i snang brnyan gyi kha dog shin tu gsal bar byung gsungs la/ de'i skabs thams cad ni/ gdul bya rnams tshogs bsog sgrib sbyong gis las la bskul bar bzhed cing / bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma la rjes su chags pa'i bgyi ba ni/ che phra gang yang don chen por 'gyur ba nyid do/ /zhes 'doms pa'i tshul gyis bsnyung tshul bstan pa tsam las/ rje nyid ni gdugs kyi 'khor lo thams cad du bde stong gi nyams gzhal du med pas 'khyud bzhin du bzhugs par the tshom dang bral ba nyid do/ /zhes nges shes brtan po dang ldan zhing / de ltar 'chi bdag gi bdud las rnam par rgyal nas/ sku tshe ring por bzhugs pa'i legs lam gyi rten 'brel mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ skya ser che phra kun gyis rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun/ dga' spro dang bcas pas/ zhal dkar gyi 'bul nod 'khos su babs pa'i legs byas ji snyed pa yang bsgrubs pa yin no/ zhes thos so/ /de nas dgung lo re dgur phebs pa sa pho stag lo/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang du gling khar rje lo chen sprul sku/ grwa tshang chen mo'i mkhan po/ mus nang nas chos rje sangs rgyas lhun grub/ zhe dgon gdan sa pa/ shar phyogs dgon gsar gyi bla ma sogs che gnyan du ma phebs gsol ba btab pa'i zhal ngor/ /dgon gnas kyi dge 'dun rags bsdus don gnyer dang ldan pa rnams dang bcas pa la/ shangs pa bka' brgyud du mtshan btags pa grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po dz+wo kis rgya gar shar nub gung gsum chu bzhin nyul/ lo bcu bdun bar dka' tshegs kyis btsal ba'i zab chos kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa nai gu chos drug yongs su rdzogs pa bka' drin du bstsal la/ de yang mos gus bskyed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/

rgyu lus dbang mo che sogs dbang gi skor/ chos drug rtsa ba'i khrid sogs khrid kyi skor/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs lung gi skor mtha' dag spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang grags pa nyid dang / grub pa'i khyu mchog rdo rje rin chen gnyis las gang gsan rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis bka' drin bskyangs shing / de skabs su gzhan yang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / bla ma rin 'byung / lam zab thun mong ba/ tshar gsum khug pa gsum gyi byin rlabs/ gong ma'i bka' 'bum thor bu ba/ ngor pa rang lugs po ti dmar chung ngu grags pa gnyis kyi lung dang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lha so gnyis/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyi 'jam rdor lha bcu dgu ma/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang sogs legs par gnang la/ gzhan yang rme brtsegs ljang sngon gyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang byed tshul dang bcas pa/ dzam dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ khyung nag gur drag khyung khra/ seng gdong sngon mo rnams kyi rjes gnang so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang / dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / de nyid kyi sgrub thabs rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mdzad pa'i yig lung dang bcas pa sogs mdor na dam pa'i chos kyi sgo grangs med pas 'di phyi kun tu phan bde'i lam la yang dag par 'god pa'i bka' drin mchog tu bstsal pa yin no/ /de nas stag lo zla ba bcu pa la thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs/ dgun chos bar/ dge 'dun gzhir bzhugs dad 'dus dang bcas pa drug brgya skor la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras rgyas par gnang zhing / de'i yos lo zla ba gsum pa la/ sde srid nam mkha' rgyal po'i drung gis spyan 'dren la brten/ dpal ldan lha rtser phebs ngos zhal ngo rnams la/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / grub rgyal ma'i dbang brgya rtsa re dang / phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed de'i dbang dang bcas pa/

gur lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / gtor dbang dang bcas pa bka' drin bskyangs ngos/ slar gling khar phebs/ thugs dben pa'i ngang nas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don snga mu ltar mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yos lo zla ba bdun par nye ba'i skabs nas/ sde srid sku mched rnams sku rim gsang shor gyi rnam pas zir bun gyi cha che tsam byung ba la/ bla ma so so spyan drangs pa'i legs sbyor thabs 'khos ji snyed pa dag gis bka' stsal nan chags su gnang yang / lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / bka' gdams pa gong ma 'ga'i gsung bgros las kyang / bya ba 'di kun rma bya'i mdongs dang 'dra/ /dang po nyid du ri mo bris zin yin/ /zhes 'byung ba don la gnas pas/ legs byas dang nyes byas kyi 'bras bu mtha' dag 'chol med du rang rang gi bgo skal du spyod pa la/ gzhan la dkrir med cing / sangs rgyas nyid kyang mthu brdugs pa'i dper song ba nas/ thugs yid 'byung ba'i rnam par song mod/ de las kyang / snying rje'i yul du gyur pa dag brtse ba chen pos gtong bar ma bzod de/ rgyu'i gyong dang lam gyi dka' tshegs gang la yang ma gzigs par/ e wam̐ chos ldan bar thugs rje'i grib bsil gyis bskyangs shing / der chos dang zang zing gnyis ka'i sgo nas phan bde'i lam bstan bya ba dang / bya ba ma yin pa'i gnas la spang blang gi tshul 'di dang 'di bgyis pas legs pa'i lam du 'gyur zhing / mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes nam yang mi 'dor ba'i nges gnas su 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs gcam bu'i zol dang bral zhing / brtse ba chen pos brlan pa bden pa'i ngag gi dkrol ba ji snyed pa dag thugs gting nas bzhar ba gnang ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas tshul bden pas stong zhing mtha' bzhi'i ngang tshul las mi 'da' ba 'di la thugs nges par 'byung ba yid skyo ba'i mkhar ba la brten te/

slar yang rang gnas gling kha chos kyi pho brang du phebs par mdzad pa yin la/ 'di'i gnas tshul rgyas par ni mi spro ste/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal gyi gsos 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir bsdus te bstan pa yin no/ /de nas 'brug lo zla ba brgyad pa la/ slar pho brang chen po ngam ring du phebs/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe bka' slob dpon dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bkral ba'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i tshe bka' brgyad cu gcig re dang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srol thun mong ma yin pa bka' bab bzhir grags pa'i nang nas/ ḍom+bi lugs ma gtogs pa gsum dang / rdo rje nag po chen po gur zhal gyi rjes gnang / mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang rgyas pa dang bcas pa bka' drin du stsol bzhin pas/ mchod yon kun zos bder bzhugs pa'i skabs/ shes rgyud gdon gyis bslad pa'i skye bo gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i mthun phyogs su 'os pa 'ga' dang 'ga'i byed pa la brten/ zir bun gyi cha chen po yongs grab sngar nas yid ches kyi thugs dam brtag pa yid la bcags pa dang / slar yang snga 'khos las nam yang 'gyur med kyi thugs dam brtag pa gdeng khel du yod pa'i byin rlabs la brten/ bya ba mtha' dag kyang mchog gsum gyi bden pas ma bslus pa'i legs lam kho nar gyur pa yin la/ de skabs ring mo zhig nas gsol ba btab pa'i rgyun dang / ched du dpal bzang ldan chos sde chen po'i che bgres slob dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thugs 'dun rtse gcig tu song ngos/ chos rje mgon khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gling dga' zhabs drung du mngags te/ snga nas rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing gsung gi bdud rtsis dge bar mdzad pa'i legs lam gyi rgyun dang / rnam par dag pa'i dam tshig la dgongs/ gsung ngag rin po che'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ci nas kyang chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba gnang dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan phul ba la brten/

thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs shing / thugs dam brtag pa yang snga phyi'i rim pa sgo mthun legs tshogs su chug la/ lhag par rje nyid kyi mnal lam du/ rdo dkar po 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i khang pa gcig brtsigs pa mthar gson pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo la brten/ phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ slar thub bstan yangs pa can du bzhugs skabs kyang / thugs dam brtag pa legs tshogs su shar ba'i rjes thogs/ da lan gyi brtag pa 'di bden yang dag pa'i lam du 'gyur na/ do nub bla ma bka' drin can zhig dang mjal te/ dges pa'i tshul gyis lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob par shog cig pa'i smon lam mdzad de gzims pas skabs gcig 'od gsal gyi cha la/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub nyid sngar bas kyang zil gzi brjid che ba'i tshul du byon cing dges dges kyi ngang nas byin rlabs mdzad pas/ da nged la rgyu lam gyi dbang bskur mdzod gsungs/ khri gnyis 'dug pa'i mtho sar/ rje 'di nyid/ gcig shos la/ rje btsun nyid bzhugs pa la ya nga bag tsha gang yang med par dbang 'bul ba'i rnam pa dang / thugs kyi 'char sgor/ nged la dang po nas mthong sos chen po yod pa de'i yin par 'dug dgongs mtshams 'od gsal sad de/ rje 'di nyid kyi thugs la/ da gang byas kyang brtag pas mi bslu ba 'dug dgongs pa shar zhing / de dang nye ba'i mnal lam zhig la yang bud med mang po rgyan gos shin tu 'chor ba dang bcas pas tshig bkra gang legs kyi glu len cing 'dug pa nas/ thugs dam brtag pa la gdeng khel gyi bka' shog dbu rgyan rdzong du mang phebs pa bka' drin bskyangs shing / de ka las ma g.yos pa'i legs byas kyi khyad par dang ldan pa yin no/ /slar yang bzang ldan nas/ zhabs bskul gyi bang chen thub bstan du 'byor pa nas/ zhabs drung yid bzhin nor bu'i drung dpon g.yog shar stabs kyis byin rlabs zhu bar phebs/ zhag bzhugs kyi tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs bka' drin bskyangs shing /

slar mthong smon du spyan drangs/ ca~Xg zhag bzhugs pa bka' drin bskyangs ngos/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs kyi legs lam slar yang spel te/ nyer drug la chibs kyi kha lo gyen du bsgyur ba'i gtsang gzhung brgyud/ rim pas tshes gnam gang la/ dpal bzang ldan chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang ga la bar phebs/ de'i nyin chos sde nas che bgres slob dpon tshang mas gtsos dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas ser 'phreng gcig tu dngar ba'i/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ phye ma phur ma/ rol mo'i bye brag ji snyed pa dang bcas pas/ phu rab bar phebs bsu bgyis shing / de'i tshe nam mkha' shin tu g.ya' dag pa rdul dang bral zhing / ser bus dben pa la/ me tog gi char gsil mar bab pa sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams dga' ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa byung bar snang la/ rgyal zla ba shar ma thag pa'i tshes gcig la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gsung chos 'dzugs par mdzad de/ de yang gzhir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa'i steng du/ phyogs nas gsung chos don du gnyer ba mang po dang / kun mkhyen dbon pos gtsos khams pa du ma dang bcas pa/ snang gsum dang sems bskyed chen mo yan stong lnga brgya skor dang / rgyu dbang skabs phye gsal phyag thor btab pa'i sngags lam la gzhan gyi 'dres med brgyad brgya skor nyi ma bcu drug gi bar du gnang zhing / de skabs spyir dag snang gi khyad par du byas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan dang ldan/ khyad par rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nyid la brten pa'i/ dam tshig gis bsdus pa'i legs mdzad la brten/ spangs rin po che dang rje bla brang rdzong pa nas gnyis kyang phebs pa'i/ dges pa rdo rje rgyu dus kyi dbang sogs gsan par mdzad cing / rje 'dis kyang ti shrī gnyis la/ rje btsun grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rje lha mchog seng ge dang / rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis kyi rnam thar rgyas bsdus kyi lung chos 'brel du gsan nas/

phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i legs lam du gyur pa yin la/ de nas sngon 'gro snang gsum gyi dmigs khrid/ dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi dmigs khrid rnams rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mdzes rgyan gyi steng nas gnang la/ de dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed rgyu lam gyi dbang / bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su/ nye bar 'khor ba bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus dmar gyi zhib mo rdo rje nas bzung / rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar bar tshang mar gnang zhing / che bgres slob dpon rnams dang / gzhan rags bsdus mi nyung tsam zhig la/ gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams dang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i phyi dkyil/ nang dkyil dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ dmigs rim re re'i sngon du yang rjes gnang re re gnang ba thog mar bcom ldan 'das tshe 'phel dkar po/ seng ge gdong can dmar sngon gnyis/ ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma/ rme brtsegs ljang sngon dud kha/ khro bo gser mig 'khyil pa/ khyung khra/ 'byung po 'dul byed me dbang dang bcas pa/ phyag rdor dbu tsa/ jo bo bcu gcig zhal/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ rje btsun sgrol ljang / gnyan gyi lugs/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gnyis/ dzam ser nag spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ dpal rta mgrin lcags ral can/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal rnams kyi rjes gnang / rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang yig lung dang bcas/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i gsung la dmar chos kyi rgyal po'i zin bris la rnam 'grel gsung bgros ma'am dmar mar grags pa'i lung ste/ mdor na zad mi shes pa'i chos kyi sgo mang po bka' drin du stsal pa la brten/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi me ro sos pa ltar mdzad pa yin zhing / de skabs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang po'i legs byas kyang spel bar mdzad pa yin no/

/de nas dgung lo don gnyis su phebs pa lcags mo sbrul lo/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga la gsung chos grol bstun/ dpal ngam ring du phebs shing / sde srid zhal ngo rnams la/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang la sogs pa zab rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa stsal nas/ rim gyis gling dgar phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor bar mdzad la/ de nas dgung lo don gsum du phebs pa chu pho rta lo gnas de nyid du gtso bor sku mtshams dang / skabs mtshams su ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor bskor cing / gling dga'/ thub bstan go gnyis la sogs pa'i chos sde mang por/ bstan pa spyi sgos 'phel rgyas kyi thabs su/ mang ja sogs gnang zhing / de nas dgung lo don bzhi pa chu mo lug lo'i dgun dpal ngam ring du phebs nas/ sde srid zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar bka' chos mang du gnang zhing / khyad par lo chen sprul pa'i sku bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad la/ de'i tshe me tog gi char babs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar dge mtshan du ma byung bar snang la/ de nas rim pas thub bstan yangs can du phebs/ grub thob brgyad bcu'i byin rlabs la sogs pa gdul bya rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams pa'i bka' chos mang du gnang zhing / de dus thub bstan mkhan chen rje byams pa rab brtan pa yangs pa can du byon nas/ mkhan chen nyid dang yangs can gyi zur 'chad gnyis/ mthong smon gyi bzhi sde dbu byed sogs dbang cha gcig la/ kye rdor bka' babs bzhi'i nang nas/ nag po lugs kyi sku gsung thugs/ snying po kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dbang bka' drin du stsal la/ de skabs mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan pas las slob phyag phyi byas nas/ ngor nas chos rje mus pa dang / kun mkhyen dbon po sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du bka' drin bskyangs shing / de nas gling dga' chos kyi pho brang du phebs/ der rten 'brel snying po dang zhen pa bzhi bral gyi nyams khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor cing /

tshogs pa la kun rig stong tshar nyis sbrel yang 'dzugs par mdzad/ de'i ston gza' skar 'dzom pa la jo mo lugs kyi rta ra can du dpon rgyal po zhi khro 'bum gyis spyan 'dren zhus nas/ dpon zhal ngo brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i dpon g.yog stobs che ba la tshe bka' brgya tshar ltag sprod/ dgong re bzhin chos skyong gi gtor dbang sogs bka' chos stobs che ba gnang zhing / hor rgyal pos kyang 'bul ba stobs che ba dang / phar yang gnang sbyin gya nom pa mdzad nas/ rje'i bka' lung la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde thabs/ khyad par mus sogs 'brog ris bde thabs kyi bka' lung nan chen gnang nas/ dpon g.yog byin phar phebs/ dpon chos rje mthu stobs gling dgar khrid nas/ bde mchog nag po pa'i bka' dbang sogs bka' chos rgya chen pos tshim par mdzad skabs der yang gling dgar kun rig stong tshar bsgrubs shing bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ slar ngam ring nas spyan 'dren nan chags phebs pa la brten/ hor zla bcu pa la ngam ring du phebs/ sde srid yab yum rnams la tshe bka' ltag sprod brgya tshar sogs gnang zhing / khyad par bdag mo phun tshogs drung la sku lus gcig yod pa rgyal bur 'khrungs pa'i thabs dang / bar chad sel ba'i drag po'i bka' dbang mang du mdzad/ sku khams kyi stabs nas bskang gso de tsam la bsdud pa mi legs sam zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas nged kyi mtshan ltas lta bu la gur gyi mgon po'i bskang gso nyi ma bcu byas na bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing / dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod gsungs pa'i lung bstan nyi ma lnga song nas byung ba/ nged la ni bsam don sgrub rgyu khyed sku mched la legs tshogs byung na bsam pa yin/ khyed sku mched la legs tshogs che ba la ni/ lha cig 'di la rgyal bu gcig 'khrungs na bsam pa yod gsungs/ bskang gso nyi ma bcu mdzad nas/ rgyal bur 'khrungs pa'i lung bstan gnang /

de nas gling dgar phebs 'phral rgyal bu 'khrungs pa'i gtam snyan 'bul ba dang mtshan zhu ba la mi gnang byung thad/ mtshan nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba sogs rten 'brel legs tshogs du ma'i sgo nas gnang / de nas gling dgar sku rim stobs che pa bsgrubs pas sku khams kyang dwangs/ sprel lo sos ngor bla brang shar pa'i drung gling dgar phebs/ bka' babs bzhi'i gtsos pa'i dbang lung stobs che ba dang / khams phyogs kyi bar chad sel phyir drag dbang kha yar gnang / rje shar pa'i drung gis kyang mang ja bdud rtsi ril bu'i 'gyed bcas phul phyin yang mdzad/ ngor nas mkhan chen dkon mchog dpal ldan pa'i drung gis da lo thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs dgos/ bdag kyang byin rlabs dang bka' dbang 'ga' zhu ba la cis kyang yong bsam pa lags zhes zhu shog phul ba la brten/ de'i dbyar thub bstan du phebs pa dang bstun/ ngor nas mkhan chen drung yang phebs nas mang ja bdud rtsi ril bu'i rten bcas kyang phul phyin mdzad/ rje ngor pa'i drung la rgyu lam gnyis/ bka' babs bzhi/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang sogs bka' chos mang du gsan pa stsal cing / rje ngor pa'i drung gis kyang tshogs pa la thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid rjes gnang kha yar dang bcas pa mdzad/ ston gling khar phebs pa dang bstun/ dpon chos rje'i drung yang phebs/ de'i dgun chos la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid lung rgyas pa dang bcas pa tshogs pa la bka' drin bskyangs/ lung la sgrub thabs mdo byas dang mdo bsre gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam gzhag rim pa gnyis klu blos mdzad pa/ cho ga nyi shu pa klu byang gis mdzad pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i sgron me sgra gcan zin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa ar+ya de bas mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron me sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i khrid yig

rje byams par rab brtan pas mdzad pa'i rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi rnam thar/ rgyu lam gyi dbang / dmar po skor gsum/ tshe bka' kha yar/ lam zab sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/ /sprel lo'i dpyid ya ma bde ldan phur phebs/ dpon chos rje zur 'chad pas gtsos pa'i bde ldan phu'i tshogs pa dang / gsang sngags rdo rje gling nas dbu mdzad pa'i gtsos pa'i dge 'dun che rags sum cu tsam dang bcas pa la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ljags lung dang bcas pa bka' drin bskyangs shing / bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba byung yang stobs che bar mdzad nas/ slar gling dgar phebs pa'i skabs shig rje sprul pa'i sku dpon slob rags bsdus gcig gling dgar phebs byung ba la/ glo bur du phebs pa ji ltar lags bka' lung gnang bas/ bdag bla ma la mjal 'dod pa zhig byung ba dang / snga mor thub bstan yangs can du 'bul ba mnos pa zhig 'bul rgyu ma byung zhus nas/ chibs bzang po gcig dang / gsol ja gsigs gcig gser srang phyed/ dar yug gos yug gis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba gya nom pa mdzad nas/ bdag la sa bdag gdon grol gyis gtsos bka' dbang byin rlabs gang che rang zhu/ zhes zhus nas/ bka' dbang byin rlabs gang che yang gnang / snga mor ngam ring nas sman sdings su phebs dus bka' lung gnang ba dang / gling dgar nai gu gnang ba'i dus rang / mgon khang du mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang gnang ba'i dus su/ 'phrin las 'chol ba sogs dang sgo bstun nas/ da lan phebs pa legs byung / bdag na so'i stabs nas rgyun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ gling dga' 'di gang gi sgo nas kyang 'dzin dka' ba nas/ khyed lta bu zhig ma gtogs pa zin rigs su mi 'dug pas/ 'di'i zhal bdag sogs 'phrin las rgya che ba rang gnang dgos gsungs/ zhal bzhugs ring bsko bzhag mdzad pa'i dgongs pa gnang yang /

rje sprul pa'i sku'i zhu cha la/ bdag bla ma dam pa sku tshe ring bar gsol ba btab/ de bar ngam ring chos sde chen por bstan pa'i rnam gzhag gcig dang / da dung zhabs pad du gtugs pas bka' chos thob rgya gang che zhu dgos pa nas/ da lta zhal bzhugs ring 'di nyid nas bka' drin che dgos shing / de nas bka' lung bdag gis bgyid legs gsungs/ de ltar gdan sa'i lung bstan rnams mdzad nas/ rje sprul pa'i sku slar gru 'dzin du phebs gling dgar zam pa gong 'og gi bcos ka dang / sku rim rgya chen mdzad skabs/ ngam ring nas spyan 'dren nan che ba byung pa nas/ sos ngam ring la phebs/ bka' chos dgongs bzhed ltar rgyas par gnang zhing / khyad par sde gsar g.yo 'khyom ches pa nas srung 'khor rgya che ba gnang ba'i/ byang gtsang gnyis mtshan byus khyad du 'phags pa'i lung bstan yang mdzad/ de ka bzhin phyis su sde srid nas kyang mtshan don bka' gnang ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bla ma'i bka' drin yin gsungs nas shin tu mnyes tshor che ba byung zhing / de skabs 'das ma 'ongs kyi bka' bkod mthil phyin par mdzad nas/ rje btsun drung gi spyan 'dren dang bstun pa'i lhun sdings su phebs/ bka' dbang 'ga' gnang skabs/ bya bzangs su gtsang byang gi mtshan byus shin tu legs pa byung ba'i gtam snyan 'bul mi dang / da lan mtshan byus 'di 'ong ba bla ma khyed kyi sku drin du gda' lags pas/ da dung yang srung 'khor gyi khong nas mi 'dor ba zhig dgos gsungs byung zhing / rim gyis gling khar phebs nas/ dpon chos rje hor yul du phebs pa la/ sku chos kyis mgo byas rab tu byung ba dgongs pa'i 'phral gyi yo byad gzhan yang gnang sbyin dang bcas pa bka' drin bskyangs nas rdzong ltar gnang / de'i ston mi sde rnams kyis da lo dpyid rtsa chog gnang ba dang / gling dga' rang du bzhugs dgos tshul zhus pas dpyid rtsa chog thub pa'i nges pa med/

rtsa chog dgos na deng sang byed gsungs nas dpon slob nyi shu rtsa bgrang gis rtsa chog rgyas par gnang / de skabs thub bstan du chos rje dbus pa spyan 'dren du phebs thad/ gling dga'i spyi chos phyag g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyis da lo mtshan ltas cung zad ngan pa tsam 'dug lags pa/ da lo 'di nyid du zhabs brtan pa zhig thugs rje che dgos zhes mgrin gcig tu zhu ba phul yang / da lan thub bstan du cis kyang 'gro/ phyis slebs pa'i nges pa med gsungs nas thub bstan du chibs kha bsgyur/ rje sprul pa'i sku dang brag snar mjal skabs/ sprul sku'i zhal nas bdag da lo rmi lam gyi ltas cung zad ngan pa tsam 'dug lags pa bka' dbang 'dra dgos gsungs nas 'bul ba gya nom pa yang phul/ bka' dbang byin rlabs gang che yang gnang nas thub bstan du bya lo'i ston phebs skabs/ rje sprul sku'i mtshan ltas dang mthun par rje'i yum zhi bar gshegs nas rje 'di nyid kyi drung du chibs pa bzang po gcig gis gtsos 'bul ba stobs che ba mdzad/ de dus 'jad nang na na tsha ngan pa byung pa la chos grwa chen po der drag po'i rjes gnang kha yar gnang bas/ dgon mo yan gyi nad rnams rbad chod cing / gzhan yang mthong smon bkras 'dzom sogs su phyag nas gnang ba'i sar sbad chod pa'i byin rlabs shin tu che bar byung zhing / de nas khyi lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gcig nas grib rkyen cung zad tsam la nyer len byas nas snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa la/ rme brtsegs kyi khrus chog /bskang gso/ mang ja bcu gcig 'gyed bcas dang / thub bstan rnam rgyal du mang ja bsngo rten sogs sku rim rgya cher bsgrubs kyang sku khams la bde khyad cher ma byung bar/ hor zla gsum pa snga ma'i nyer gcig la chibs kha bsgyur nas nyer lnga la gling dgar phebs te/ der dge 'dun rnams kyis kun rig stong tshar/ sher snying 'bum gter/ sgrol ma 'bum gter/

bskang gso/ rnam rgyal stong khrus/ rnam 'joms khrus chog tshe chog sogs bsgrubs shing / de thad tshogs pa la mang ja sum cu so lnga/ nas khal re 'bo re tsam dang / na bza' dar ras sogs skam 'gyed kyang stobs che ba/ chos sde so so la gnang sbyin/ las 'dzin rnams la rnam gzhag sogs dang / rta mo lung pa la nas 'gyed gnyis dang / slas pa stod smad la'ang nas 'gyed dang / bde ldan phur yang mang ja bcu sbrel/ nas khal phyed re/ rdo rje gling / sle lung / dga' ldan rtse rnams su mang ja re dang rta bzang ba gcig sa skyar mang ja dang / zhabs drung du bkra shis kha dar/ gzim ber/ chibs pa bzang ba gcig sgo rum/ kha'u/ pu tra lha khang rnams su/ snyan dar/ dkar me gtor gsos sogs mdor na zla ba gcig gi nang du sku rim lhod med dang sman spyad phul 'dug cing / de'i skabs shig sku drung na mchis pa rnams dang / sman pa rnams kyis sku khams nyog tshul zhus pas/ khyed rnams la de ltar snang yang nga la ni/ stong nyams dang bde nyams 'ba' zhig ma gtogs na ba'i mi bde ba'i gnas skabs skad cig tsam yang med gsungs shing / yang re zhig nas gsol sman mchod na zhus pas/ de bzhin byed khyed rnams blo kha tshims 'gro gsungs/ yang nyin gcig mnal mdzad kyin gda' lags zhus pas/ khyed kyi mthong snang la/ ngas ni rje btsun sgrol ma khro gnyer can ma/ rig byed ma/ seng gdong ma rnams byon byung pas/ de rnams kyi snying po ci mang re bzlas pa yin/ gnyid byas pa med gsungs pa dang / yang nyin gcig mnal ma mdzad lags zhus pas/ mthong snang ma chung bar sdod/ da lta dpal rta mgrin mi g.yo ba phyag rdor rnams byon 'dug pas/ bzlas pa re byas pa yin gsungs shing / yang re zhig na dpal ldan chos skyong gi 'od zer gyis thams cad la khyab song gsungs pa dang / nyin gcig bkra shis brtan pa gsungs/ ci lags zhus pas/ bkra shis brtan pa la sogs pa'i bla ma mang po byon 'dug gsungs/

tshes nyi shu'i snga bar ha ha zhes bzhad sgra zhig gnang byung ba la/ ci lags zhus pas/ khyed kyis ma mthong ngam/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub sngar bas kyang gzi mdangs dang na bza' khyad par 'phags pa mdzad nas byon byung gsungs pa sogs thugs nyams 'ba' zhig las/ snyung ba'i rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' yang / zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i smon lam dang / khyad par mdo las/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po 'dra ba yis/ /lus can rnams ni smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dman pa'i gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams la nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed cing / zhing khams gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs nas/ dgung lo bdun cu don bdun du phebs pa me pho khyi'i lo hor zla gsum pa phyi ma'i tshes nyi shu'i dgong / thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams tshang bar mdzad nas zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag mnyam gzhag tu mdzad nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'da' ka ma zab mo gsal btab ste/ sku'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bzhugs pa la spyan gzigs nas dgongs pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du thim pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de ma thag rje sems dpa' chen po/ grub chen/ 'jam dbyangs gsum gyi sku 'dra la snyan dar bzang ba re/ mar me/ tshogs pa la mang ja rnams bsgrubs/ nyer gcig snga dro thugs dam las bzhengs nas thogs pa med par rje bla ma yab sras kyi drung du gshegs pa la the tshom dang yid gnyis mi dgos pa lags/ de'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi yo byad so sor song ba rnams smos na/ sa skyar 'jam dbyangs mi'i sku gzugs can sku mched drung du/ gser sku/ dbu rgyan bya spu ma/ rten kheb/ zhal dkar shub bcas/ gos ber/ tib khra/ ras dkar rnams dngos gtsang / dge 'dun tshogs pa la mang ja/ sil snyan/ shel rgyan/ rta gcig sman sdings su thugs rje'i mnga' bdag lo chen sprul pa'i sku'i drung du/

gser sku/ zhal dkar 'bras shel shub bcas/ lcug tib/ na bza' li khri ma/ chibs sga 'khor dang bcas pa/ ras dkar yug rnams dngos gtsang / ngor du mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog dpal ldan pa'i drung du/ rten kheb/ gser sku/ dngul phor/ sku chos/ sil snyan hor phrug rta gcig pa khri yug rnams dngos gtsang / spyi 'bul rta bzang ba gcig thub bstan rnam rgyal du/ bsngo rten/ rten kheb/ gser sku/ rgya dril/ sku thabs/ chibs pa/ lcug tib/ sgril dmar/ mang ja/ spyi 'gyed rten khebs gser ma/ rten kheb pho ris ma/ hor dkar shub bcas/ bla bre gnyis/ sil snyan/ rta gcig rnams dngos gtsang ba/ thub bstan yangs can du/ mang ja'i thog gzim zhwa/ bla brang na yod pa'i spyad dngos kyi steng nas/ slob dpon gnyis la bka' babs byas nas byin tshogs pa la 'bul ba byas/ de nas nyer gsum gyi nyin/ bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'dren pa dam pa/ chos kyi rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dbu mdzad pa/ byang 'dren pa la sogs pa'i bde mchog rtsa sngags kyi bsnyen pa song ba gsum/ mdo sngags kyis rgyud phyug cing rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i khams pa rab 'byams pa gcig kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun/ 'grel pa dag ldan/ lam 'bras dmar ma/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum sogs byang zhabs drung du phul ba'i dge slong gcig sogs kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen song ba bcu gcig gis kye rdor la brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sku gdung zhugs la phul bas/ du ba 'ja' gur du khebs pa dang / dri bzang pos khyab pa dang / zhi bar gshegs pa nas bzung ste/ de dag gi skabs phal cher du/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / lha'i me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas dpag med byung zhing / de nas bzung ste de rnams kyi dgung zhag gi ring / kye rdo rje'i sgrub mchod tshar gnyis re/ bla ma mchod chog

sku gdung la rten khrus rnams 'bul bar mdzad/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu drug gza' skar 'dzom pa la gdung khang zhal phye bas ring bsrel du ma dang / dbu thod ril por byon cing / phyis bsod nams can dad ldan 'ga' zhig gi phyag tu/ lha sku/ yig 'bru/ ring bsrel sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar dpag med byung bar snang ngo / /mdor na gsol 'debs kyi dngos gzhi nyer lnga la tshugs nas ma grol bar la dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis snga dro kun rig bla ma mchod chog dgong mo rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod mdzad par gnang zhing / de dag gi bsnyen bkur gyi rkang blang bla brang nas byin gzhi bzung / zur 'debs rje btsun sa skya pa sku mched/ lo chen sprul pa'i sku sogs kyis gtso mdzad/ ngor gling dga'/ thub bstan go gnyis kyi bu slob rnams dang / byang nas sa skyong mi dbang zhal ngo rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ dpon chen dang / phyogs rigs kyi sbyin bdag sku 'khor du gtogs pa'i sbyin bdag la sogs pa dad pa can rnams kyis kyang / tha dad rang rang gi dad gus chen pos gang la gang 'bab kyi gdung 'bul/ dkar me'i rgyun/ phal cher gyis mang ja/ 'ga' zhig gis mang ja nyis sbrel/ 'ga' zhig gis nas 'gyed la sogs pa re re nas brjod par mi nus pas mdor na dpag tu med pa'i yo byad sbyar te zhag grangs du ma'i bar du tshogs chen la 'bul 'gyed/ rnyed bkur la sogs pa gya nom par bsgrubs shing / phyogs su bsgrubs pa 'ga' zhig gong du smos zin la/ 'bul yig ltar brjod pa yi ger 'jigs nas ma spros shing mdor bsdus na/ de las gzhan ngam ring chos sde/ bzang ldan/ zhe dgon/ sman sdings/ ri bo gru 'dzin/ shar phyogs dgon par/ lo dgon pa/ na len+d+ra rnams dang / mus su gtogs pa'i bde ldan phu/ rdo rje gling / sle lung / dga' ldan rtse/ mkhar steng / mtha' gong sogs dgon sde so sor/

mang ja/ bsngo rten/ nas mar/ skam zong / khrag chags la sogs pa'i 'gyed chas gang la gang 'bab phul du phyin pa dang / rta slas gnyis sogs skye bo'i tshogs rgya chen po la'ang nas 'gyed/ khrag chags la sogs pa'i sbyin gtong dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad par gnang zhing / gling dga' dang bde ldan phug gnyis su zla dus kyi mchod pa dang / dus chen yang rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi mchod pa ltar btsugs shing / gzim mal gyi sku tshab tu rje nyid kyi sku brnyan mi tshad tsam sman skur bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ sa paṇa gyi 'phel gdung / kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i gzungs kyi snying po can du byas shing / bshad ma thag pa de nyid kyi ring bsrel dang / rje nyid kyi ring bsrel sogs rten dang gzungs sngags kyi snying po can gyi rten yang bzhengs te/ bzo rigs pa rnams so sor gnang sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa du mas rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i rab tu gnas pa phun sum tshogs pa grub nas mchod pa rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod de byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dad ldan gyi slob ma dang / sbyin bdag so sos lo zla dus kyi mchod pa chag med du bsgrubs shing / rje nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa'i bshes gnyen bsam gyis mi khyab pas bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan pa nyi zla ji srid gnas pa de srid du spel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ni de lta bu'i rje btsun bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho de nyid kyi rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ gnas so sor gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po legs par bskor bar mdzad nas/

bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskrun te/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / khyad par 'khrul pa'i dri ma bral ba rje btsun sa skya pa'i mdo sngags kyi legs par dkar ba'i chu gter chen pos yongs su gang ba'i skal ba bzang por mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar bskrun pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rags rim brjod na/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dam par sku 'khrungs pa bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / bdag chen rin po che ngag dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gdan sa pa/ chos kyi rje rin po che dkon mchog dpal ldan pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gangs can gyi mgon du byon pa lo chen rat+na bha dra'i sprul pa'i sku/ shrī na len+d+ra'i khri thog pa chos rje rin po che lum pa ba/ ti shrī rje spangs rin po che dang rje bla brang rdzong nas/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi gdan sa pa chos rje rin po che blo gros rgyal po/ grwa tshang chen mo'i gdan sa pa chos rje dkon mchog bzang po ba/ sa skya sngags dgon gyi mkhan po chos kyi rje dpal ldan bzang po ba sku mched/ gle lung chos sde'i mkhan po chos rje chos dbang phyug pa/ gnyag ston chos rje sangs rgyas lhun grub pa/ zhe dgon gdan sa pa chos rje chos rgyal mtshan pa/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po'i gdung brgyud chos rje 'gyur med bde chen pa sku mched/ dngul chu'i gdan sa pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas dar po/ chos 'khor gnas kyi gdan sa pa rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ rdzong dga' ldan rtse dang gling dga'i gdan sa pa bdag cag lhar bcas yongs kyi 'dren pa dam pa mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan pa/ de'i zur 'chad ru thog chos 'od zer ba/

chos rje 'bum rab 'byams pa rgyal ba blo gros pa/ chos rje rin chen grub/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi zur 'chad pa chos rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ba dang / chos rje dbang phyug dpal bzang pa/ ngor nas zur 'chad pa chos rje mus pa/ gsang phu na dwags po drung chen chos rje kun dga' 'byung gnas/ bde ldan phug gi zur 'chad pa chos rje blo gros legs pa/ chos rje chos 'phel ba/ shar phyogs dgon par gyi chos rje nam mkha' rin chen pa/ khams phyogs na chos rje kun mkhyen dbon po sku mched/ a li chos rje/ gling dbon chen gyi chos rje/ ngam ring bzang ldan sogs chos sde chen po rnams kyi grwa tshang so so'i 'chad nyan 'dzin pa dang bod gangs can gyi yul so so na/ blo gsal gyi 'khor bsdus nas rang dbang du bshad nyan skyong ba dang / dgon pa dang dben gnas so so na/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin lhur len pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang ba sogs kyis ring nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bgrang ba las 'das pa bskrun par mdzad de/ de dag gi dngos kyi slob ma yang slob la sogs te bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rgyun mar byon nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du mus chen sems dpa' chen po yab sras rje nyid dang bcas pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun mi nyams shing gong 'phel du gyur pa 'di yin no/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum dngos mkhyen pa'i gter/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar 'di bkod pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa yis/ /bcas rang gis bsdus nyes kun byang gyur cig /nges don bstan pa'i srog shing mus pa rje/ /sems dpa' chen po yab sras 'phrin las rgyun/ /yongs 'dzin khyod kyis srid mthar spel ba ltar/ /bdag gi brgyud rigs dang chos kyi 'dzin rnams kyis de 'drar shog /bdag dang bdag la gcig tu yid gtad pa'i/

/gdul bya 'di rnams dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub phyi ma lhan cig par/ /bde ba can skyes re smon kun 'grub shog /ces khams gsum gyi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam bshad pa 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang lo zhe gcig lon pa me mo glang gi lo gdan sa chen por gsung ngag tshar bdun pa bshad dus/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho nyid kyi rnam thar che ba rnams nas bsdus te legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa gdong dga' pa bsam pa don chen gyis mgyogs par bgyis pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /yang smras pa/ thub dbang gshegs nas me glang 'di yan la/ /mi lo sum stong bdun brgya don gcig 'das/ /de phyir rnam dag bstan pa'i lhag ma ni/ /mdo sde dus kyi nyis brgya nyer dgu dang / /'dul ba'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gcig ste/ /de nas rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya par/ /sleb par sngon byon gong ma'i bstan rtsis kyi/ /gsung rab rnams la bltas pas nges shes skye/ /zhes kyang smras so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// /gcig zhus dag/ ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 70 a myes zhabs/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 51
